n5-040.title: Noun は～
n5-040.shortExplanation: Used to mark the topic of a sentence; 'as for', 'speaking of'.
n5-040.usageNote: は marks the topic, what the sentence is about (私は学生です).

n5-125.title: ～の
n5-125.formation: Noun1 + の + Noun2, (Adjective/Clause) + の (nominalized), etc.
n5-125.shortExplanation: Express possession, apposition, or description using 'of' or ''s'.

n5-011.title: A は B が〜
n5-011.formation: A は (Topic) + B が (Characteristic/Feature) + Description/Action
n5-011.shortExplanation: Indicates that there is something unique or different about A and describes what is special about it.
n5-011.usageNote: A は B が + description: a feature of A (彼女は髪が長い). が marks the feature.

n5-911.title: Plain: な-Adjective だ
n5-911.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + だ: 静かだ, 学生だ.
n5-911.shortExplanation: The plain copula. な-adjectives are noun-like: they take だ rather than inflecting.
n5-911.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-915.title: Polite: な-Adjective です
n5-915.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + です: 静かです, 学生です.
n5-915.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-913.title: Negative: な-Adjective じゃない
n5-913.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + じゃない (formal: ではない): 静かじゃない.
n5-913.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-917.title: Polite negative: な-Adjective じゃないです
n5-917.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + じゃないです (also じゃありません, ではありません).
n5-917.shortExplanation: The polite negative copula, with equally correct variants.
n5-917.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-912.title: Plain past: な-Adjective だった
n5-912.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + だった: 静かだった, 学生だった.
n5-912.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-916.title: Polite past: な-Adjective でした
n5-916.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + でした: 静かでした.
n5-916.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-914.title: Past negative: な-Adjective じゃなかった
n5-914.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + じゃなかった (formal: ではなかった).
n5-914.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-918.title: て-form: な-Adjective で
n5-918.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + で: 静かで, 学生で.
n5-918.shortExplanation: The connective で that joins clauses, the copula's て-form.
n5-918.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-921.title: Negative て-form: な-Adjective じゃなくて
n5-921.formation: な-Adjective / Noun + じゃなくて (formal: ではなくて).
n5-921.shortExplanation: The negative て-form of the copula, for joining and correcting.
n5-921.chapterTitle: The copula: だ and です

n5-901.title: Polite present: Verb ます
n5-901.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + ます. Godan shift the final syllable to the い-row (書く -> 書き); ichidan drop る (食べる -> 食べ).
n5-901.shortExplanation: The polite non-past form, the default register of everyday spoken Japanese.

n5-902.title: Polite past: Verb ました
n5-902.shortExplanation: The polite past tense: 書きました, 食べました.

n5-903.title: Polite negative: Verb ません
n5-903.shortExplanation: The polite negative: 書きません, 食べません.

n5-904.title: Polite past negative: Verb ませんでした
n5-904.derives: polite past negative (ませんでした)
n5-904.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + ませんでした.
n5-904.shortExplanation: The polite past negative: 書きませんでした.

n5-064.title: ～あります
n5-064.shortExplanation: Indicate possession or existence of inanimate objects; 'there is', 'there are'.

n5-032.title: Noun に～
n5-032.shortExplanation: Express a specific direction, target or purpose; 'to', 'toward', 'for'.
n5-032.usageNote: に: a destination, a time, where something exists, or a recipient (日本に行く).

n5-030.title: Nounで～
n5-030.shortExplanation: Indicate a place or means for an action or situation; 'at, in, on', 'using', or 'by means of'.
n5-030.usageNote: で: where an action happens (図書館で勉強する), or the means (バスで).

n5-043.title: Noun を〜
n5-043.shortExplanation: Indicates the direct object of a verb.

n5-037.title: Noun に 行きます
n5-037.shortExplanation: Used to express going to a location.
n5-037.usageNote: 行く: move toward somewhere away from where you are now (学校に行く). The に differs in role: Noun + に + 行きます marks the destination (駅に行きます, 'go to the station'), Verb-ますstem + に + 行きます marks the purpose (見に行きます, 'go in order to watch').
n5-037.familyName: Going And Coming (Go / Come / Go Back)

n5-036.title: Noun に 来ます
n5-036.shortExplanation: Used to express coming to a place.
n5-036.usageNote: 来る: move toward the speaker's place (友達が家に来る). The に differs in role: Noun + に + 来ます marks the destination (家に来ます, 'come to the house'), Verb-ますstem + に + 来ます marks the purpose (会いに来ます, 'come in order to meet').
n5-036.familyName: Going And Coming (Go / Come / Go Back)

n5-033.title: Noun に 帰ります
n5-033.shortExplanation: Express going back or returning to a place: 'to return to', 'to go back to'.
n5-033.usageNote: Returning to a place you belong: home, your hometown, your country.
n5-033.familyName: Going And Coming (Go / Come / Go Back)

n5-051.title: Noun に 戻ります
n5-051.shortExplanation: Expresses the action of returning to a previous state, place, or condition.
n5-051.usageNote: Reverse back to a place or state you were at before: your desk, an earlier state.
n5-051.familyName: Going And Coming (Go / Come / Go Back)

n5-090.title: だれ～
n5-090.formation: だれ + appropriate particle (が, は or を)
n5-090.shortExplanation: Asking 'who' in a sentence, used to inquire about someone's identity or to clarify who is being referred to.
n5-090.usageNote: The everyday 'who', fine with friends and in most questions. Polite: どなた.

n5-115.title: なに～
n5-115.formation: Verb + なに, い-Adjective + なに, な-Adjective + なに, Noun + なに
n5-115.usageNote: なに before を, が, も and most particles (なにを食べますか). Before です, a counter, or で/の, use なん.

n5-119.title: なん～
n5-119.formation: なん + Counter / なん + Verb / なん + Adjective
n5-119.shortExplanation: Used to form interrogative questions and emphasize the question word for 'what', 'how'.
n5-119.usageNote: なん before です, a counter, or で/の/と (なんですか, なん歳). Elsewhere, なに.

n5-101.title: どこ～
n5-101.shortExplanation: Express 'where', used with question words for asking about locations.
n5-101.usageNote: 'Where': asks for a place (どこに行きますか). Polite: どちら.

n5-110.title: どちら～
n5-110.formation: どちら + が/を + verb, どちら + が/を + adjective, どちら + が/を + noun
n5-110.shortExplanation: Used to ask about two choices or options.
n5-110.usageNote: 'Which (of two)', and the polite 'where / which way'. For three or more, どれ or どの.

n5-111.title: どなた～
n5-111.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask 'who', used for asking about someone's identity or when seeking information about an unknown person.
n5-111.usageNote: Polite 'who': strangers, customers, superiors, on the phone or at the door (どなたですか).

n5-112.title: どの Noun
n5-112.shortExplanation: Expresses 'which'; used to ask about specific items within a group.
n5-112.usageNote: 'Which' among three or more, always before a noun (どの本). Of two, どちら.

n5-114.title: どんな Noun
n5-114.shortExplanation: Used to ask or describe 'what kind' or 'what type' of something.
n5-114.usageNote: Everyday 'what kind of' (どんな食べ物が好きですか).
n5-114.familyName: What Kind (What Kind Of / That Kind Of)

n5-066.title: いくつ～
n5-066.shortExplanation: Used to express 'how many' or ask for the number of something.
n5-066.usageNote: 'How many' for things counted without a special counter, and 'how old'. With a counter, なん + counter.

n5-097.title: どうやって～
n5-097.shortExplanation: Ask 'how' something is done or how to do something.
n5-097.usageNote: 'How, by what means': asks for the method (どうやって行きますか).
n5-097.familyName: How (By What Means / How Do You Say It)

n5-120.title: なんで～
n5-120.shortExplanation: Asking the reason or cause; 'why', 'how come'.
n5-120.usageNote: Casual 'why' (なんで遅れたの？). Same sound as なに + で, 'by what means', so context decides.

n5-095.title: ～どう しますか。
n5-095.shortExplanation: Asking for someone's opinion or decision; 'what will you do?', 'how will you handle it?'.
n5-095.usageNote: 'What will you do?': asks for a decision (どうしますか), not a method.
n5-095.familyName: How (By What Means / How Do You Say It)

n5-096.title: ～どうですか。
n5-096.formation: Noun + は/が + どうですか / Verb-casual + の + どうですか / い-Adjective + どうですか / な-Adjective + な + どうですか
n5-096.shortExplanation: Asking for opinions or suggestions; 'how about', 'what do you think of'.
n5-096.usageNote: Neutral 'how about / how is it' (コーヒーはどうですか). Polite: いかがですか.

n5-098.title: ～どう 言いますか。
n5-098.formation: Word/Phrase + は [language]でどう言いますか / Word/Phrase + をどう言いますか
n5-098.shortExplanation: Asking for the way to say something; 'how do you say'.
n5-098.usageNote: Asks for the wording in a language (「ありがとう」は英語でどう言いますか).
n5-098.familyName: How (By What Means / How Do You Say It)

n5-122.title: ～なんと 言いますか。
n5-122.formation: Noun + は/が + なんと言いますか
n5-122.shortExplanation: Asking how something is called or referred to; 'how do you say'
n5-122.usageNote: Asks what something is called, its name (この花はなんと言いますか).
n5-122.familyName: How (By What Means / How Do You Say It)

n5-091.title: だれか〜
n5-091.formation: だれか + Verb, だれか + Adjective, だれか + Noun
n5-091.shortExplanation: Indicates 'someone' or something done or possessed by 'someone'.
n5-091.usageNote: 'Someone': a person you do not name (だれか来ました). A statement, not a question.

n5-102.title: どこか～
n5-102.shortExplanation: Expresses 'somewhere', used when the specific location is unknown or uncertain.
n5-102.usageNote: 'Somewhere': a place you do not name (どこかに行きたい). A statement, not a question.

n5-116.title: なにか～
n5-116.usageNote: 'Something': a thing you do not name (なにか食べたい). A statement, not a question.

n5-067.title: いつか～
n5-067.shortExplanation: Indicates an unspecified point in time; 'someday', 'one day', 'at some point'.
n5-067.usageNote: 'Someday, at some point': a time you do not name (いつか日本に行きたい).

n5-092.title: だれでも～
n5-092.shortExplanation: Used to express 'anyone' or 'everyone'; 'no matter who'.
n5-092.usageNote: 'Anyone at all', whoever it is, with an affirmative verb (だれでもできます).

n5-103.title: どこでも～
n5-103.formation: Simply use the word どこでも in the sentence as an adverb to indicate 'anywhere' or 'everywhere'.
n5-103.usageNote: 'Anywhere at all', wherever it is, with an affirmative verb (どこでも寝られます).

n5-121.title: なんでも～
n5-121.formation: なんでも + Verb / なんでも + Adjective / なんでも + Noun
n5-121.usageNote: 'Anything at all', whatever it is, with an affirmative verb (なんでも食べます).

n5-113.title: どれでも～
n5-113.shortExplanation: Indicates 'any' or 'whichever' when referring to multiple items.
n5-113.usageNote: 'Any of them, whichever' with an affirmative verb (どれでもいいです).

n5-094.title: だれも～ません
n5-094.shortExplanation: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in negative sentences.
n5-094.usageNote: 'No one': だれも needs a negative verb (だれも来ませんでした). With an affirmative, だれでも.

n5-118.title: なにも～ません
n5-118.formation: なにも + Verb-ます form + ません
n5-118.usageNote: 'Nothing': なにも needs a negative verb (なにも食べませんでした). With an affirmative, なんでも.

n5-105.title: どこにも + Verb + ません
n5-105.shortExplanation: Express 'not anywhere' or 'nowhere' with a negative verb.
n5-105.usageNote: 'Nowhere': どこにも + a negative verb (どこにも行きません). With an affirmative, どこでも.

n5-016.title: い-Adjective: Negative Polite Form
n5-016.formation: い-Adjective (remove い, add く) + ないです / ありません
n5-016.shortExplanation: Change an い-adjective into a polite negative form with ～くないです (or ～くありません).

n5-014.title: い-Adjective く + Verb
n5-014.shortExplanation: Used to connect an い-adjective to a verb, modifying the verb (adverbial usage).
n5-014.usageNote: い-adjectives: drop い, add く (早く起きる). な-adjectives take に.

n5-017.title: い-Adjective て
n5-017.formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + くて + い-Adjective
n5-017.shortExplanation: Used to connect two or more い-adjectives to describe something.
n5-017.usageNote: い-adjectives join with くて (安くておいしい). な-adjectives and nouns take で.

n5-018.title: な-Adjective に + Verb
n5-018.shortExplanation: Turn a な-adjective into an adverb by adding に.
n5-018.usageNote: な-adjectives: add に (静かに話す). い-adjectives take く.

n5-019.title: な-Adjective で～
n5-019.shortExplanation: Usage of で to connect or add information with a な-adjective.
n5-019.usageNote: な-adjectives and nouns join with で (静かできれい). い-adjectives take くて.

n5-908.title: Plain negative: い-Adjective くない
n5-908.formation: Drop the final い and add くない: 高い -> 高くない. Irregular: いい -> よくない.
n5-908.shortExplanation: The plain negative of an い-adjective.

n5-909.title: Past: い-Adjective かった
n5-909.formation: Drop the final い and add かった: 高い -> 高かった. Irregular: いい -> よかった.
n5-909.shortExplanation: The plain past of an い-adjective.

n5-910.title: Past negative: い-Adjective くなかった
n5-910.formation: Drop the final い and add くなかった: 高い -> 高くなかった.
n5-910.shortExplanation: The plain past negative of an い-adjective.

n5-920.title: Negative て-form: い-Adjective くなくて
n5-920.formation: Drop the final い and add くなくて: 高い -> 高くなくて. Irregular: いい -> よくなくて.
n5-920.shortExplanation: The negative て-form of an い-adjective, for joining and giving reasons.

n5-015.title: い-Adjective く します
n5-015.formation: い-Adjective (remove い, add く) + します
n5-015.shortExplanation: Use an い-adjective to express 'to make' or 'to become'.
n5-015.usageNote: くする: you MAKE it so (部屋を明るくする). くなる: it BECOMES so.

n5-020.title: な-Adjective に します
n5-020.shortExplanation: Expressing a decision or preference with a な-adjective.
n5-020.usageNote: にする: you make it so (静かにする). になる: it becomes so.

n5-021.title: な-Adjective に なります
n5-021.formation: な-Adjective (remove な) + に + なります
n5-021.shortExplanation: Express a change or transformation into a state described by the な-adjective.
n5-021.usageNote: になる: it becomes so, by itself or over time (元気になる). にする: you make it so.

n5-034.title: Noun に します
n5-034.shortExplanation: Express a choice or decision; 'choose', 'decide on'.
n5-034.usageNote: 'I'll have / go with X': a choice (寿司にします), not a change.

n5-035.title: Noun に なります
n5-035.shortExplanation: Expresses change or becoming something; 'to become', 'to turn into', 'to be'.
n5-035.usageNote: 'Become X' (医者になる); also a time arriving (春になる).

n5-046.title: Verb て～
n5-046.formation: Verb (Group 1) - Replace last syllable with 〜て, Verb (Group 2) - Replace 'る' with 〜て, Verb (Group 3) - する becomes して, くる becomes きて
n5-046.shortExplanation: A verb conjugation that connects actions or states.

n5-047.title: Verb て います
n5-047.shortExplanation: Express ongoing action or state; 'is doing', 'is doing (continuous)', 'has been doing'.
n5-047.usageNote: ている: an action in progress, or the state left by a change (結婚している).
n5-047.familyName: Resulting State (Is Doing / Has Been Done / In Advance)

n5-049.title: Verb て ください
n5-049.usageNote: The standard 'please do' (見てください). Softer: てくださいませんか. Who acts is the difference: Verb-て + ください asks someone else to act (帰ってください, 'please go home'), Verb-causative + て + ください asks permission to act yourself (帰らせてください, 'please let me go home').

n5-050.title: Verb ないで ください
n5-050.formation: Verb-ない-form + で ください
n5-050.shortExplanation: Used to make a polite request for someone not to do something; 'please don't'.
n5-050.usageNote: 'Please don't': the negative request (見ないでください).

n5-905.title: Plain past: Verb た
n5-905.formation: Formed exactly like the て-form, with た/だ instead of て/で: 書いて -> 書いた, 飲んで -> 飲んだ, 行って -> 行った, 食べて -> 食べた.
n5-905.shortExplanation: The plain (casual) past tense, and the base many later patterns attach to.
n5-905.chapterTitle: Plain verb forms: past and negative

n5-906.title: Plain negative: Verb ない
n5-906.formation: Verb (ない-stem / 未然形) + ない. Godan shift to the あ-row, with わ for the う-ending (書く -> 書かない, 買う -> 買わない); ichidan drop る (食べる -> 食べない).
n5-906.shortExplanation: The plain (casual) negative, and the base for negative patterns.
n5-906.chapterTitle: Plain verb forms: past and negative

n5-907.title: Plain past negative: Verb なかった
n5-907.shortExplanation: The plain past negative: 書かなかった, 食べなかった.
n5-907.chapterTitle: Plain verb forms: past and negative

n5-919.title: Negative て-form: Verb なくて
n5-919.formation: Verb (ない-stem) + なくて: 書く -> 書かなくて, 食べる -> 食べなくて; する -> しなくて, 来る -> 来なくて. It is the て-form of the negative ない.
n5-919.shortExplanation: The negative counterpart of the て-form: joins clauses and gives reasons in the negative.
n5-919.chapterTitle: Plain verb forms: past and negative

n5-039.title: Noun の 前に
n5-039.shortExplanation: Used to describe a location or position 'in front of' a noun.
n5-039.usageNote: Noun の前に: in front of a place (駅の前に), or before an event (食事の前に).

n5-061.title: Verb る 前に
n5-061.shortExplanation: Used to express 'before' in a sense of an action must be done before another action or event.

n5-038.title: Noun の あとで
n5-038.shortExplanation: Expresses the order of events; 'after', 'later than'.
n5-038.usageNote: The everyday, plain "after X" - simple sequencing.

n5-044.title: Verb た あとで
n5-044.shortExplanation: Indicates an action that takes place after another action.
n5-044.usageNote: Verb た + あとで: after doing (食べたあとで). With a noun: のあとで.

n5-048.title: Verb てから～
n5-048.shortExplanation: Express a sequence of actions or events; 'after', 'since', 'once'.
n5-048.usageNote: The everyday "after doing X, then..." - simple sequencing, doubles as "since" for a state that began at that point.

n5-099.title: ～とき
n5-099.formation: Verb-casual + とき / い-Adjective + とき / な-Adjective + なとき / Noun + のとき
n5-099.shortExplanation: Expresses the time when something happens, 'when', 'at the time'.
n5-099.usageNote: The standard "when" - the everyday default for stating the time something happens.

n5-025.title: Noun から Noun まで
n5-025.formation: Noun1 + から + Noun2 + まで
n5-025.usageNote: The everyday "from X to Y" range marker.

n5-028.title: Noun ごろ～
n5-028.shortExplanation: Expresses 'around' or 'about' a certain time or age.
n5-028.usageNote: Same idea as くらい/ぐらい but specifically for a POINT IN TIME ("around 3 o'clock"), not a quantity - doesn't substitute for くらい/ぐらい on quantities.

n5-026.title: Noun くらい～
n5-026.shortExplanation: Express the extent or degree of something; 'about', 'approximately', 'at least'.
n5-026.usageNote: Neutral, standard way to express an approximate quantity or degree. (Near-duplicate of n3-012 - same word, taught at both N3 and N5.)

n5-045.title: Verb たいです
n5-045.formation: る-Verb: Remove る and add たいです, う-Verb: Replace the final verb character with the ～い form and add たいです, Exception: する becomes したいです
n5-045.shortExplanation: Express desire or want to do something; 'I want to', 'I would like to'.
n5-045.usageNote: たい: want to DO something yourself (食べたい). A thing is ほしい.
n5-045.familyName: Wanting (Want / Want To / Want Someone To)

n5-024.title: Noun がほしいです
n5-024.formation: Noun + が + ほしいです
n5-024.shortExplanation: Express a desire or wanting something; 'I want', 'I would like'.
n5-024.usageNote: ほしい: want a THING (車がほしい). Wanting to DO something is たい.
n5-024.familyName: Wanting (Want / Want To / Want Someone To)

n5-023.title: Noun が できます
n5-023.shortExplanation: Express the ability to do something.
n5-023.usageNote: Noun + ができる: can do an activity or skill (日本語ができる).

n5-057.title: Verb ること～
n5-057.shortExplanation: Express an action or event as a noun; 'the act of', 'doing'.

n5-060.title: Verb る の～
n5-060.shortExplanation: Used to express the purpose or reason in casual speech, or nominalize the verb with の.
n5-060.usageNote: Casual sentence-final の: explains, or asks for an explanation. Polite: のです / んです.

n5-059.title: Verb る こと ができる
n5-059.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ことができる
n5-059.shortExplanation: Expresses the potential form; 'can', 'be able to', 'is possible'.

n5-012.title: A は B より～
n5-012.formation: A は B より + Adjective
n5-012.shortExplanation: Express a comparison between A and B; 'A is more/less than B'.
n5-012.usageNote: 'A is more ~ than B': より marks the thing A is measured against.

n5-013.title: A より B のほうが～
n5-013.romaji: A yori B no hou ga ～
n5-013.formation: A + より + B + のほうが + Adjective
n5-013.shortExplanation: Used to compare two items; 'B is more ～ than A'.
n5-013.usageNote: 'B is more ~ than A': the usual answer to a どちら question (Bのほうが好きです).

n5-001.title: A が いちばん～
n5-001.formation: Noun + が + いちばん + Adjective/Verb
n5-001.shortExplanation: Express the superlative degree; 'the most', 'the best', 'the least'.
n5-001.usageNote: 'The most': among three or more, often after の中で or では (Aがいちばん好きです).

n5-009.title: Aと Bと どちら～
n5-009.formation: Aと Bと どちら + Verb/Adjective/Noun
n5-009.shortExplanation: Used to ask which of two alternatives is preferred or to compare two things
n5-009.usageNote: Asks which of two (AとBとどちらが～ですか). Casual: どっち.

n5-010.title: AとBと どっち〜
n5-010.formation: AとBと どっち + Verb, AかBか どっち + Verb
n5-010.usageNote: Casual どちら, with friends and family (AとBとどっちが好き？).

n5-041.title: Noun も〜
n5-041.shortExplanation: Indicates that the action or state is the same for multiple items or people; 'also', 'as well'.
n5-041.usageNote: The plain particle "also/too". (Near-duplicate of n4-118 - same particle, taught at both N4 and N5.)

n5-031.title: Noun と～
n5-031.shortExplanation: Express 'with', 'and' or 'together with' when connecting nouns.
n5-031.usageNote: The plain particle "and/with" for connecting nouns.

n5-042.title: Noun や Noun など～
n5-042.shortExplanation: Lists items or examples but not exhaustively; 'such as', 'like', 'and so on'.
n5-042.usageNote: "And, such as" - pairs や (partial "and") with など (etc.).

n5-022.title: Noun か Noun か～
n5-022.usageNote: Neutral, everyday "A or B" for simple choices.

n5-029.title: Noun だけ〜
n5-029.formation: Noun + だけ, Verb-casual + だけ, い-Adjective + だけ, な-Adjective-な + だけ
n5-029.usageNote: Simple, neutral "only/just" - the everyday default for stating a plain restriction.

n5-089.title: ～たり、～たり します
n5-089.formation: Verb-casual-past + たり + Verb-casual-past + たり + します
n5-089.shortExplanation: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'do things like', 'and'.
n5-089.usageNote: Lists representative actions rather than nouns/examples - "does things like X and Y" - a different construction from とか/など but the same non-exhaustive-listing idea.

n3-073.title: ～など
n3-073.shortExplanation: Indicates a non-exhaustive list of examples; 'such as', 'things like', 'among others'.
n3-073.usageNote: The standard, everyday non-exhaustive list marker - "such as/etc.".

n3-074.title: ～なんか
n3-074.formation: Noun + なんか, Verb-casual + なんか, い-Adjective + なんか, な-Adjective + なんか
n3-074.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'things like' or 'something like', used for listing examples or downplaying something.
n3-074.usageNote: Casual など, often dismissive (お金なんかいらない).

n3-030.title: ～それと～
n3-030.shortExplanation: Used to link two or more items; 'and', 'also'.
n3-030.usageNote: Casual "and also" - a conversational way to add an afterthought.

n5-073.title: ～から、～
n5-073.formation: Verb-casual + から / い-Adjective + から / な-Adjective + だから / Noun + だから
n5-073.usageNote: Everyday spoken default for stating a reason; emphasizes the speaker's subjective reason.

n5-074.title: ～からです
n5-074.formation: Verb-casual + からです / い-Adjective + からです / な-Adjective + だからです / Noun + だからです
n5-074.shortExplanation: Express the reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
n5-074.usageNote: Polite (です) form of から, typically answering "why?" directly.

n5-088.title: A。だから、～B。
n5-088.formation: Sentence A + だから + Sentence B
n5-088.usageNote: Blunt, conversational "so"; can sound abrupt or child-like if overused in formal contexts.

n3-072.title: ～なぜなら
n3-072.formation: Sentence/Statement + なぜなら + Reason + から/だから
n3-072.shortExplanation: Express a reason or explanation; 'because', 'the reason is'.
n3-072.usageNote: Formal written connective introducing an explanation ("the reason is..."); essays, articles, speeches.

n2-060.title: ～ことから
n2-060.formation: Verb-casual + ことから / い-Adjective + ことから / な-Adjective + なことから / Noun + のことから
n2-060.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason or basis for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
n2-060.usageNote: Descriptive/explanatory - "based on the fact that...", common in written explanations rather than casual speech.

n5-071.title: ～が
n5-071.formation: Noun + が / い-Adjective + が / な-Adjective + が / Verb + が
n5-071.shortExplanation: Particle indicating the subject of a sentence or expressing 'but'.
n5-071.usageNote: The plain particle "but"; natural in both speech and writing, softer/more neutral-sounding than けど.

n5-077.title: ～けど、～
n5-077.formation: Verb-casual + けど / い-adjective + けど / な-adjective + だけど / Noun + だけど
n5-077.usageNote: Casual, mid-sentence; the everyday spoken default among the "but" family.

n5-078.title: ～けれど、～
n5-078.formation: Verb-casual + けれど / い-Adjective + けれど / な-Adjective + だけれど / Noun + だけれど
n5-078.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.
n5-078.usageNote: Slightly more formal than けど but still conversational; safe in most spoken contexts.

n5-008.title: A。でも、～B。
n5-008.formation: Clause A + でも + Clause B
n5-008.shortExplanation: Used to express contrast between two statements; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.
n5-008.usageNote: Casual speech; fine with friends and family, avoid in writing or formal settings.

n5-003.title: A。しかし、～B。
n5-003.formation: Sentence A + しかし + Sentence B.
n5-003.shortExplanation: Expresses contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.
n5-003.usageNote: Formal/written; essays, news, presentations. Rare in casual spoken conversation.

n5-002.title: A。けれども、～B。
n5-002.formation: Statement A + けれども、+ Statement B
n5-002.shortExplanation: Used to express a contrast between two statements. It can be translated as 'but' or 'however'.
n5-002.usageNote: Formal writing or very polite speech; a business email or public speech, not casual conversation.

n3-033.title: だけど
n3-033.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.
n3-033.usageNote: だ + けど, used after nouns/na-adjectives instead of bare けど. Same register as けど.

n2-016.title: A。だが B。
n2-016.formation: Sentence A + だが + Sentence B
n2-016.usageNote: Blunt, assertive "but"; common in writing, speeches, and narration - less soft than けど, less formal-sounding than しかし.

n2-156.title: ～ものの、～
n2-156.formation: Verb-casual + ものの, い-Adjective + ものの, な-Adjective + なものの, Noun + であるものの
n2-156.shortExplanation: Indicates contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'although', 'but'.
n2-156.usageNote: Formal, written register - common in essays and news reporting; rare in casual speech.

n5-083.title: そして、～
n5-083.shortExplanation: Used to connect two sentences; 'and then', 'and'.
n5-083.usageNote: The standard connector for sequential sentences - "and/and then"; common in writing too.

n5-085.title: それから、～
n5-085.shortExplanation: Meaning 'after that', 'and then' or 'then', indicating sequence of events.
n5-085.usageNote: Casual, everyday "after that/and then" - simple narrative sequencing.

n5-006.title: A。それでは、～B。
n5-006.formation: A (Statement) + 。それでは、 + B (Follow-up action or statement)
n5-006.shortExplanation: Express a change in situation; 'then', 'in that case', 'so'.
n5-006.usageNote: "Well then/in that case" - acts on what was just said. Also heard as それじゃ, or as bare じゃ.

n5-007.title: A。 では、～B。
n5-007.formation: Noun A + では、 + Subject + Predicate B
n5-007.shortExplanation: Indicates a contrast or comparison between A and B; 'As for A, ~B'.
n5-007.usageNote: The topic-restriction particle ("as for X, among X"), NOT the それでは connective it looks like.

n3-001.title: A その上 B
n3-001.shortExplanation: Used to express 'in addition to', 'besides', or 'furthermore' when adding information or making a suggestion.

n2-002.title: A。おまけに B。
n2-002.formation: Sentence A + おまけに + Sentence B
n2-002.shortExplanation: Expresses that in addition to A, there is also B; 'moreover', 'besides', 'not only', 'but also'.

n2-004.title: A。しかも B。
n2-004.usageNote: Formal-leaning "moreover" - common in both speech and writing, often for a surprising addition.

n2-023.title: A。なおB。
n2-023.usageNote: Formal, written "additionally/note that" - common in official notices and documents.

n5-054.title: Verb ましょう
n5-054.shortExplanation: Making a suggestion or invitation; 'let's' or 'shall we'.

n5-055.title: Verb ましょうか。
n5-055.shortExplanation: Used to make a polite suggestion or offer help; 'shall we', 'should we', 'do you want me to'.
n5-055.usageNote: Neutral "shall we.../shall I..." - offers to do something together or for someone.

n5-056.title: Verb ませんか。
n5-056.shortExplanation: An invitation or suggestion; 'won't you', 'why don't you', 'shall we'.
n5-056.usageNote: Slightly more polite/deferential "won't you..." - invites without presuming agreement.

n5-065.title: ～いかがですか。
n5-065.formation: Noun + は + いかがですか / (Verb-て form + は) いかがですか
n5-065.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask someone's thoughts, opinions, or preferences; 'how about', 'how is'.
n5-065.usageNote: Polite "how about..." - asks for a preference/opinion rather than proposing an action directly.

n5-123.title: ～に あげます
n5-123.formation: Receiver + に + Object + を + あげます
n5-123.shortExplanation: Used to express giving something to someone; 'give', 'offer'.
n5-123.usageNote: The plain "give". (Polite ます-form of n4-013's あげる.)

n5-124.title: ～に もらいます
n5-124.formation: Giver + に + Verb-te form + もらいます / Giver + に + Object + を + もらいます
n5-124.shortExplanation: To receive something or some action from someone; 'to get', 'to receive'.
n5-124.usageNote: Neutral, polite (ます) form - the standard textbook way to say "receive".

n5-076.title: ～が 私に くれます
n5-076.formation: Person + が + (Thing or Action) + 私に + くれます
n5-076.shortExplanation: Used to express that someone gives a gift or favor to 'me'; 'someone gives me'.
n5-076.usageNote: Neutral - someone giving TO the speaker. (Polite ます-form of n4-016's くれる.)

n5-075.title: ～から もらいます
n5-075.formation: Noun + から + (Verb-て form) + もらいます
n5-075.shortExplanation: To receive something or get someone to do something.
n5-075.usageNote: The everyday, polite "receive". (から-marked source variant of the もらう family.)

n5-069.title: いつも～
n5-069.usageNote: "Always/usually" - describes a habitual state or repeated occurrence.

n5-135.title: よく～
n5-135.shortExplanation: Often used to express 'doing something well' or 'often'.
n5-135.usageNote: 'Often' with a verb (よく行く); also 'well' (よく分かる).

n5-100.title: ときどき～
n5-100.shortExplanation: Used to indicate the frequency of an event; 'sometimes', 'occasionally', 'now and then'.

n5-087.title: たいてい～
n5-087.usageNote: 'Usually, most of the time': more often than よく, less than いつも.

n5-086.title: だいたい〜
n5-086.usageNote: A freestanding adverb ("roughly, for the most part"), not attached to a number like くらい/ぐらい - broader, less precise approximation.

n5-127.title: ほとんど〜
n5-127.formation: ほとんど + Verb / ほとんど + Noun

n5-062.title: あまり～ありません
n5-062.formation: あまり + Verb-ないform + ありません / あまり + い-Adjective-く ありません / あまり + な-Adjective・Noun じゃありません, あまり + Verb-negative, あまり + い-Adjective-negative
n5-062.shortExplanation: Express 'not very', 'not much', or 'not really' when describing a negative state or situation.
n5-062.usageNote: 'Not very, not much': a partial negative. 'Not at all' is ぜんぜん.
n5-062.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n5-082.title: ぜんぜん～
n5-082.shortExplanation: Used to express 'not at all' or 'completely' in negative sentences.
n5-082.usageNote: The everyday, common "not at all" - very frequent in speech.
n5-082.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n5-128.title: まあまあ～
n5-128.formation: まあまあ (used as an adverb or short expression - not a strict grammatical construction)

n5-134.title: もっと〜
n5-134.formation: もっと + Verb / い-Adjective / な-Adjective
n5-134.shortExplanation: Expresses 'more' or 'even more' when describing a quantity, frequency, or degree.
n5-134.usageNote: 'More' of a quality or amount (もっと大きい). Comparing two named things uses より.

n3-098.title: まったく～ない
n3-098.formation: まったく + Verb-negative, まったく + い-Adjective-negative, まったく + な-Adjective-negative
n3-098.usageNote: まったく～ない: not at all; less casual than ぜんぜん.
n3-098.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n5-132.title: もう～
n5-132.formation: もう + Verb / もう + Adjective / もう + Noun
n5-132.usageNote: 'Already' (もう食べた); with a negative, 'not anymore' (もう行かない).

n5-129.title: まだ〜
n5-129.formation: まだ + Verb (non-past / negative / te-form), まだ + い-adjective, まだ + な-adjective + じゃない/ではない, まだ + Noun + じゃない/ではない
n5-129.shortExplanation: Indicates something has not yet happened or is still happening; 'still', 'not yet'.
n5-129.usageNote: 'Still', with an affirmative verb (まだ寝ている).

n5-131.title: まだ～ません
n5-131.shortExplanation: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet (polite form).
n5-131.usageNote: 'Not yet' (まだ食べていません): the answer to もう～ましたか.

n5-133.title: もうすぐ〜
n5-133.formation: もうすぐ + Verb (~ます form or 〜る form)
n5-133.shortExplanation: Express an action or event happening soon: 'soon', 'in a short while', 'almost'.
n5-133.usageNote: 'Soon': an event is coming up (もうすぐ夏休み).
n5-133.familyName: Close In Time (Soon / Right Away / A Moment Ago)

n5-081.title: すぐに～
n5-081.shortExplanation: Immediately or right away; used to express promptness or quickness.
n5-081.familyName: Close In Time (Soon / Right Away / A Moment Ago)

n5-080.title: さっき～
n5-080.formation: さっき + verb / さっき + phrase
n5-080.shortExplanation: Refers to a short time ago or just now.
n5-080.usageNote: 'A moment ago, just now': the past (さっき食べた).
n5-080.familyName: Close In Time (Soon / Right Away / A Moment Ago)

n5-079.title: こちら～
n5-079.formation: こちら / こちら + の + Person/Thing
n5-079.shortExplanation: Refers to a person, place or thing; 'this', 'this one', 'this way', 'here'.

n5-084.title: そちら～
n5-084.formation: そちら [alone] / そちら + の + Noun
n5-084.shortExplanation: Indicates a direction or person in moderate distance; 'that way', 'that person'.

n5-126.title: ～はたいへんです
n5-126.shortExplanation: Express that something is difficult or tough.

n4-022.title: Verb た ことがある
n4-022.shortExplanation: Expresses the experience of having done something in the past.
n4-022.usageNote: た + ことがある: 'have done before', an experience (行ったことがある).
n4-022.familyName: Experience And Occasion (Have Done / Sometimes Do)

n4-064.title: Verb る ことがある
n4-064.shortExplanation: Used to express that something happens sometimes or has happened before.
n4-064.usageNote: Dictionary form + ことがある: 'sometimes does' (遅れることがある). Polarity is the only difference: Verb-dictionary + ことがある is 'there are times when I do', Verb-ない + ことがある is 'there are times when I don't'.
n4-064.familyName: Experience And Occasion (Have Done / Sometimes Do)

n4-063.title: Verb られる
n4-063.formation: う-verb (passive): Replace the final う with われる / る-verb (passive & potential): Replace る with られる / Irregular: する -> される, くる -> こられる
n4-063.shortExplanation: Expresses passive voice or potential form for verbs.
n4-063.usageNote: られる: passive, be done to (先生にほめられる); for ichidan verbs also 'can'.
n4-063.familyName: Causative And Passive (Make / Be Done To / Be Made To)

n4-021.title: Verb させる
n4-021.formation: Group 1 Verbs: Change the last hiragana to ～せる, Group 2 Verbs: Remove ～る and add ～させる, Group 3 Verbs: する -> させる, くる -> こさせる
n4-021.shortExplanation: Expresses 'to make someone do something', 'to let someone do something', or 'to cause someone to do something'.
n4-021.usageNote: させる: make or let someone do (子供に野菜を食べさせる).
n4-021.familyName: Causative And Passive (Make / Be Done To / Be Made To)

n4-020.title: Verb させられる
n4-020.formation: Verb-causative stem + せる + られる (irregular: する -> させられる, くる -> こさせられる)
n4-020.shortExplanation: Express the passive causative form; 'to be made to', 'to be forced to'.
n4-020.usageNote: させられる: be made to do, against your will (待たせられる).
n4-020.familyName: Causative And Passive (Make / Be Done To / Be Made To)

n4-080.title: ～させてください
n4-080.shortExplanation: Express a polite request to allow or permit someone to do something.
n4-080.usageNote: 'Please let ME do it': asks permission for your own action (行かせてください).

n4-901.title: Volitional: Verb よう／おう
n4-901.formation: Godan shift to the お-row + う (書く -> 書こう, 買う -> 買おう); ichidan drop る + よう (食べる -> 食べよう); する -> しよう, 来る -> 来よう.
n4-901.shortExplanation: The plain 'let's / I think I'll' form, the casual counterpart of ましょう.

n4-902.title: Imperative: Verb 命令形
n4-902.formation: Godan shift to the え-row (書く -> 書け, 飲む -> 飲め); ichidan drop る + ろ (食べる -> 食べろ); する -> しろ, 来る -> 来い.
n4-902.shortExplanation: The blunt command form, used in orders, signs, and rough speech.

n4-903.title: Prohibitive: Verb な
n4-903.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + な: 行くな, 食べるな, するな.
n4-903.shortExplanation: A blunt 'do not do this' command.

n4-904.title: Provisional conditional: Verb ば
n4-904.formation: Godan shift to the え-row + ば (書く -> 書けば); ichidan drop る + れば (食べる -> 食べれば); する -> すれば, 来る -> 来れば.
n4-904.shortExplanation: The general 'if / whenever' conditional, stating a natural or logical consequence.

n4-905.title: Conditional: い-Adjective ければ
n4-905.formation: Drop the final い and add ければ: 高い -> 高ければ. Irregular: いい -> よければ.

n4-029.title: Verb て ある
n4-029.shortExplanation: Indicates that an action has been done and its result is still in effect.
n4-029.usageNote: てある: someone did it on purpose and the result remains (窓が開けてある).
n4-029.familyName: Resulting State (Is Doing / Has Been Done / In Advance)

n4-037.title: Verb ておく
n4-037.shortExplanation: Perform an action in preparation for a future situation; 'to do something in advance'.
n4-037.usageNote: ておく: do it in advance, to be ready (予約しておく).
n4-037.familyName: Resulting State (Is Doing / Has Been Done / In Advance)

n4-044.title: Verb てしまう
n4-044.shortExplanation: Expresses unintentional actions or actions with regrettable outcomes; 'to end up doing', 'to accidentally do'.
n4-044.usageNote: て + しまう: done completely, or done with regret (忘れてしまった).

n4-046.title: Verb てみる
n4-046.shortExplanation: Used to express 'try to' or 'attempt to do'.
n4-046.usageNote: て + みる: try doing it to see how it goes (食べてみる).
n4-046.familyName: Trying (Try Doing / Try To / Refuse To)

n4-030.title: Verb て いく
n4-030.shortExplanation: Expresses an action that continues on into the future or a change that progresses over time.
n4-030.usageNote: ていく: change continuing from now on, or moving away (増えていく).
n4-030.familyName: Direction Of Change (From Now On / Up To Now)

n4-040.title: Verb て くる
n4-040.shortExplanation: An action that starts in the past and continues to the present or future; 'come to', 'begin to', 'become'.
n4-040.usageNote: てくる: change up to now, or moving toward the speaker (寒くなってきた).
n4-040.familyName: Direction Of Change (From Now On / Up To Now)

n4-013.title: Noun を あげる
n4-013.usageNote: The plain "give" - speaker giving to someone at equal/lower status.

n4-016.title: Noun を くれる
n4-016.formation: Giver + が + Receiver + に + Noun + を + くれる
n4-016.shortExplanation: Expresses that someone gives a thing to the speaker or someone close to the speaker.
n4-016.usageNote: Neutral - someone giving TO the speaker (or the speaker's in-group), equal/lower status giver.

n4-018.title: Noun もらう
n4-018.shortExplanation: To receive or get something from someone; 'to receive', 'to get'.
n4-018.usageNote: Neutral, plain-form counterpart of もらいます - the everyday "receive/get".

n4-014.title: Nounをいただく
n4-014.shortExplanation: To receive or accept something politely; 'to receive', 'to get', 'to accept'.
n4-014.usageNote: Humble/polite - lowers the speaker relative to the giver; used with someone of higher status.

n4-015.title: Nounをくださる
n4-015.shortExplanation: Used to express someone doing something as a favor or for the benefit of the speaker.
n4-015.usageNote: Honorific - someone of higher status giving to the speaker, as a favor.

n4-017.title: Noun を さしあげる
n4-017.formation: Noun + を + さしあげる
n4-017.shortExplanation: A polite way of expressing to give something.
n4-017.usageNote: Humble - the speaker giving to someone of higher status.

n4-028.title: Verb てあげる
n4-028.shortExplanation: Used to express doing something for someone; 'do something for someone'.
n4-028.usageNote: Neutral - doing something for someone at equal/lower status, as a favor.
n4-028.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-042.title: Verb て くれる
n4-042.shortExplanation: Expresses that someone does something for the speaker (or another person in speaker's group); 'to do something for me/us'.
n4-042.usageNote: Neutral - someone doing something for the speaker, as a favor.
n4-042.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-048.title: Verb て もらう
n4-048.shortExplanation: Express receiving a favor or action from someone.
n4-048.usageNote: Neutral - the speaker receiving the favor of someone doing something.
n4-048.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-032.title: Verb ていただく
n4-032.shortExplanation: Used to express receiving someone's favor or help; 'to kindly do'.
n4-032.usageNote: Humble - receiving the favor of someone (usually higher-status) doing something.
n4-032.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-039.title: Verb て くださる
n4-039.shortExplanation: Expresses gratitude for receiving someone's favor; 'to kindly do'.
n4-039.usageNote: Honorific - someone of higher status doing something for the speaker, as a favor.
n4-039.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-043.title: Verb て + さしあげる
n4-043.shortExplanation: A polite way to express giving or doing something for someone.
n4-043.usageNote: Humble - the speaker doing something for someone of higher status, as a favor.
n4-043.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

n4-041.title: Verb てくれませんか
n4-041.formation: Verb-て form + くれませんか
n4-041.shortExplanation: A polite way to request someone to do something for you; 'Could you please', 'Would you please', 'Won't you'.

n4-049.title: Verb てもらえませんか
n4-049.formation: Verb-て form + もらえませんか
n4-049.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask for a favor or request someone to do something.
n4-049.usageNote: Neutral "could you..." - similar register to てくれませんか, slightly softer.

n4-047.title: Verb てもらいたい
n4-047.shortExplanation: Express a desire to receive a favor or service from someone else.
n4-047.usageNote: Neutral "I'd like you to..." - less formal than ていただきたい.

n4-031.title: Verb ていただきたい
n4-031.formation: Verb-て form + いただきたい
n4-031.shortExplanation: Express a polite request or desire that someone does something for you.
n4-031.usageNote: Polite "I would like you to..." - a statement of desire rather than a direct question.

n4-033.title: Verb て いただけませんか
n4-033.formation: Verb-て form + いただけませんか
n4-033.shortExplanation: A polite request; 'Could you please...', 'Would you mind...'
n4-033.usageNote: The most formal/humble request form - "could you possibly...".

n4-038.title: Verb て くださいませんか
n4-038.formation: Verb in て-form + くださいませんか
n4-038.shortExplanation: Polite request for asking someone for a favor.

n4-103.title: ～ないといけない
n4-103.usageNote: Conversational but not as casual as なきゃ/なくちゃ; common in everyday polite speech.

n4-104.title: ～なきゃいけない
n4-104.formation: Verb-casual (negative form without い) + なきゃいけない
n4-104.shortExplanation: Express a necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
n4-104.usageNote: Casual contraction (なければ -> なきゃ); the most common everyday spoken form.

n4-106.title: ～なくてはいけない
n4-106.formation: Verb-negative form + なくてはいけない
n4-106.shortExplanation: Expresses the necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
n4-106.usageNote: Slightly less stiff than なければならない, still fine in most polite contexts.

n4-108.title: ～なければ ならない
n4-108.formation: Verb-ない form + なければ ならない
n4-108.shortExplanation: Express obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
n4-108.usageNote: The full, uncontracted form; safe in writing and formal speech.

n4-107.title: ～なくてもいい
n4-107.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is not necessary to do; 'it's okay if not', 'don't have to'.
n4-107.usageNote: The everyday 'don't have to' (行かなくてもいい). Not permission: that is てもいい.

n4-096.title: ～てもいい
n4-096.shortExplanation: To give or ask permission; 'it's okay to', 'may', 'can'.
n4-096.usageNote: 'May, it's OK to': permission (入ってもいい). Refusing it: てはいけない.

n4-095.title: ～てはいけない
n4-095.usageNote: Everyday prohibition; common in daily instructions and rules (including for children) - less stiff than てはならない.

n3-071.title: ～ないと
n3-071.usageNote: Casual 'I have to', the rest (いけない) left off (もう行かないと).

n2-132.title: ～ねばならない
n2-132.formation: Verb-ない form -> (remove い) -> ね + ばならない
n2-132.shortExplanation: Expresses obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
n2-132.usageNote: Literary/legal-sounding contraction of なければならない; textbook and formal writing register, rare in speech.

n2-088.title: ～てはならない
n2-088.formation: Verb-て form + はならない
n2-088.usageNote: Strong, formal prohibition; common in rules, warnings, and formal speech.

n2-145.title: ～べきではない
n2-145.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べき + ではない
n2-145.shortExplanation: Express that an action should not be done; 'should not', 'ought not to'.
n2-145.usageNote: Formal normative judgment - "should not", based on what's proper or expected, not a hard rule.

n1-239.title: ～差し支えない
n1-239.formation: Verb-て form + も差し支えない, Noun + が差し支えない
n1-239.shortExplanation: Indicates no problem or obstacle; 'it’s fine if...', 'there’s no issue'.
n1-239.usageNote: て(も)差し支えない: formal 'it is fine to', permission.

n4-025.title: Verb たほうがいい
n4-025.shortExplanation: Used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone - 'it's better if...'.
n4-025.usageNote: Direct advice, 'you'd better' (休んだほうがいい); stronger than たらいい. Polarity is the only difference: Verb-た + ほうがいい advises doing it, Verb-ない + ほうがいい advises against it.

n4-087.title: ～たらいい
n4-087.shortExplanation: Expressing a desire or suggestion for a particular outcome; 'it would be good if', 'should', 'I hope'.
n4-087.usageNote: Casual, softer suggestion - "it'd be good if.../I hope...".

n4-088.title: ～たら いかがですか
n4-088.formation: Verb-casual, past + たら いかがですか, い-Adjective + かったら いかがですか, な-Adjective + だったら いかがですか, Noun + だったら いかがですか
n4-088.shortExplanation: Making polite suggestions; 'how about if', 'what if', 'it would be good if'.
n4-088.usageNote: Polite, formal suggestion - "how about...?" - much more formal than たらいい/ばいい, used with someone you should be respectful toward.

n4-089.title: ～たら どうですか
n4-089.formation: Verb-た form + ら どうですか
n4-089.shortExplanation: Express a suggestion or advice; 'what if', 'how about', 'why don't you'.
n4-089.usageNote: Neutral suggestion, 'why don't you' (聞いたらどうですか). Polite: たらいかがですか.

n4-098.title: ～といい
n4-098.formation: Verb-casual + といい, い-Adjective + といい, な-Adjective + だといい, Noun + だといい
n4-098.shortExplanation: Express a wish or hope; 'I hope', 'it would be good if'.
n4-098.usageNote: Casual "I hope.../it'd be nice if..." - similar register to たらいい/ばいい.

n4-113.title: ～ばいい
n4-113.formation: Verb-ば-form + いい, い-Adjective + ければいい, な-Adjective + であればいい, Noun + であればいい
n4-113.shortExplanation: Express a suggestion or advice; 'should', 'it would be good if'.
n4-113.usageNote: Casual, softer suggestion - "it'd be good if...", near-identical register to たらいい.

n4-055.title: Verb なさい
n4-055.shortExplanation: A command form used to give orders or instructions; 'Please do', 'Do this'.
n4-055.usageNote: A command from a parent, teacher or exam: too bossy for a request to an equal.

n4-027.title: Verb つもり
n4-027.shortExplanation: Express the intention, plan, or determination to do something; 'I intend to', 'I plan to', 'I'm determined to'.

n4-058.title: Verb ようと思う
n4-058.shortExplanation: Express intention or plan to do something; 'I think I will', 'I plan to', 'I intend to'.
n4-058.usageNote: "I think I will.../I plan to" - a slightly softer statement of intention than つもりだ.

n4-026.title: Verb ために
n4-026.formation:
1) Verb (dictionary form) + ために (purpose)
2) い-Adjective + ために (reason)
3) な-Adjective + な + ために (reason)
4) Noun + の + ために (reason)
n4-026.shortExplanation: Used to describe the purpose or reason for an action; 'for the sake of', 'in order to', 'because of'.
n4-026.usageNote: Neutral, common purpose marker - "for the sake of/in order to"; safe in most contexts. (Verb-attached form of n4-010's のために.)

n4-010.title: のために
n4-010.shortExplanation: Used to express purpose or reason; 'for', 'for the sake of', 'in order to'.
n4-010.usageNote: Neutral, common purpose marker - "for the sake of/in order to"; safe in most contexts.

n4-059.title: Verb ように
n4-059.formation: Examples: Noun + のように / Verb-casual + ように / い-adjective + ように
n4-059.shortExplanation: Used to express 'like', 'as if', 'in order to', or 'so that'.
n4-059.usageNote: Softer purpose marker, typically paired with potential-form or state verbs. (Near-duplicate of n3-112 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

n4-060.title: Verb ようにする
n4-060.shortExplanation: Make an effort to; try to; see to it that; ensure that.
n4-060.usageNote: ようにする: make an effort, see to it (毎日運動するようにする). Deliberate.
n4-060.familyName: Effort And Change (Try To / Come To)

n4-061.title: Verb ようになる
n4-061.shortExplanation: Express a change in ability, situation or state; 'become able to', 'come to', 'begin to'.
n4-061.usageNote: ようになる: come to, become able (泳げるようになる). A change that happens.
n4-061.familyName: Effort And Change (Try To / Come To)

n4-062.title: Verb ように言う
n4-062.shortExplanation: Tell someone to do something; 'tell to do', 'instruct to do'.
n4-062.usageNote: ように言う: tell someone to do something (早く来るように言った).

n1-187.title: ～つもりだ
n1-187.shortExplanation: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan.

n1-188.title: ～つもりで
n1-188.shortExplanation: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan; 'with the intention of', 'planning to'.
n1-188.usageNote: The standard "intend to/plan to", used adverbially before another clause.

n4-077.title: ～かもしれない
n4-077.formation: Verb-casual + かもしれない, い-Adjective + かもしれない, な-Adjective + だかもしれない, Noun + だかもしれない

n4-091.title: ～だろう
n4-091.formation: Verb-casual + だろう, い-Adjective (drop い) + だろう, な-Adjective + だろう, Noun + だろう
n4-091.shortExplanation: Express probability, likelihood or certainty; 'probably', 'maybe', 'I think'.
n4-091.usageNote: Casual conjecture - "probably", the plain-form counterpart of でしょう.

n4-119.title: ～ようだ
n4-119.formation: Verb-て form + ようだ, い-Adjective (drop い) + ようだ, な-Adjective + のようだ, Noun + のようだ
n4-119.shortExplanation: Expresses appearance, similarity or inference; 'it seems', 'it looks like', 'it appears'.
n4-119.usageNote: Inference from one's own senses/observation - "it looks like/it seems (based on what I see)".

n4-117.title: ～みたいだ
n4-117.formation: Verb-casual + みたいだ, い-Adjective + みたいだ, な-Adjective + みたいだ, Noun + みたいだ
n4-117.shortExplanation: Indicates similarity, resemblance or 'like'; 'it seems', 'appears', 'looks like'.
n4-117.usageNote: Casual, spoken "seems like/looks like" - the everyday default for resemblance. (Near-duplicate of n3-103 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

n4-084.title: ～そうだ
n4-084.formation: Verb-ますstem + そうだ, い-Adjective (without い) + そうだ, な-Adjective + そうだ
n4-084.shortExplanation: Express the appearance, seeming, or feeling of something; 'looks like', 'seems', 'appears'.
n4-084.usageNote: ます stem + そうだ: looks like, judged from what you see (おいしそう).

n4-074.title: ～かしら
n4-074.formation: Verb-casual + かしら, い-Adjective + かしら, な-Adjective + かしら, Noun + かしら
n4-074.shortExplanation: Indicates uncertainty or doubt; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
n4-074.usageNote: Casual, traditionally feminine-coded "I wonder" - softer, more old-fashioned than かなあ.

n4-076.title: ～かなあ
n4-076.formation: Verb-casual + かなあ, い-Adjective + かなあ, (な-Adjective/Noun) + (だ) + かなあ
n4-076.shortExplanation: Expresses uncertainty or wonder; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
n4-076.usageNote: Casual, unisex "I wonder" - a soft, musing tone. (Near-duplicate of n3-006 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

n3-126.title: ～んだって
n3-126.formation: Verb-casual + んだって, い-Adjective + んだって, な-Adjective + なんだって, Noun + なんだって
n3-126.shortExplanation: Conveys information heard from someone else; 'I heard', 'They said'.
n3-126.usageNote: Casual, spoken hearsay - "I heard (that)...", conversational tone.

n2-049.title: ～かのようだ
n2-049.formation: Verb-casual + かのようだ, い-Adjective + かのようだ, な-Adjective + であるかのようだ, Noun + であるかのようだ
n2-049.shortExplanation: Express a similarity or comparison; 'as if', 'like', 'as though'.
n2-049.usageNote: Formal "as if/as though" - a deliberate, considered comparison; common in writing.

n4-101.title: ～と思う
n4-101.formation: Verb-casual + と思う, い-Adjective + と思う, な-Adjective + だと思う, Noun + だと思う
n4-101.shortExplanation: Express one's thoughts or opinions; 'I think', 'I believe'.
n4-101.usageNote: Plain form + と思う: 'I think that'. Volitional + と思う (行こうと思う): 'I'm thinking of doing'.

n4-102.title: ～という
n4-102.formation: Verb-casual + という, い-Adjective + という, な-Adjective + という, Noun + という
n4-102.shortExplanation: Used to quote, express hearsay or define something.
n4-102.usageNote: Quotes or reports something said, or defines it (～ということ, ～というのは). Position is the difference: X + という on its own reports or defines ('they say that X'), X + という + Noun names the noun that follows it (「ハリー・ポッター」という本, 'a book called Harry Potter').

n4-099.title: ～という (〜to iu) Noun
n4-099.formation: Noun + という + Noun, な-Adjective + という + Noun, Adjectival Verb + という + Noun
n4-099.shortExplanation: Used to define or explain a noun more specifically.
n4-099.usageNote: 'A ~ called X' (田中という人). Casual speech: っていう.

n4-092.title: ～っていう
n4-092.shortExplanation: Used to quote, define, or specify a noun.
n4-092.usageNote: Casual という: 'called' or 'that says', in conversation (田中っていう人).

n4-100.title: どういう Noun
n4-100.shortExplanation: Asking for clarification or more information about a noun; 'what kind of', 'what sort of'.
n4-100.usageNote: 'What kind of, what sort': often asks for an explanation (どういう意味ですか).
n4-100.familyName: What Kind (What Kind Of / That Kind Of)

n4-075.title: ～かどうか
n4-075.formation: Verb-casual + かどうか, い-Adjective + かどうか, な-Adjective + (だ)かどうか, Noun + (だ)かどうか
n4-075.shortExplanation: Used to express 'whether' or 'if' in indirect questions or statements.
n4-075.usageNote: Embedded yes/no question, 'whether or not' (来るかどうか分からない).

n4-111.title: ～のです
n4-111.formation: Verb-casual + のです, い-Adjective + のです, な-Adjective + なのです, Noun + なのです
n4-111.shortExplanation: Provides an explanation or gives background information; 'the fact is', 'the reason is', 'actually'.
n4-111.usageNote: "The fact is/the reason is" - explains or justifies with a bit more formality than んです.

n4-110.title: ～ので
n4-110.formation: Verb-casual + ので, い-Adjective + ので, な-Adjective + なので, Noun + なので
n4-110.shortExplanation: Express a reason or a cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'so'.
n4-110.usageNote: Softer and more objective-sounding than から; common in polite/formal spoken Japanese and written explanations.

n4-112.title: ～のに
n4-112.formation: Verb-casual + のに, い-Adjective + のに, な-Adjective + なのに, Noun + なのに
n4-112.shortExplanation: Used to express contrast between expectation and reality, or to indicate a purpose for doing something
n4-112.usageNote: 'Even though', with disappointment or complaint (勉強したのに落ちた).

n4-081.title: ～し、～し、～
n4-081.formation: Verb-casual + し, い-Adjective + し, な-Adjective + だし, Noun + だし
n4-081.usageNote: Lists multiple reasons casually-to-neutrally; implies "and there's more I could add".

n4-023.title: Verb た ときに
n4-023.shortExplanation: Express an action or event that occurred at a specific time in the past; 'when', 'at the time'.
n4-023.usageNote: Past-tense form of とき - not a different register, just a different verb tense.

n4-068.title: Verb るときに
n4-068.shortExplanation: Describes the time when a certain action takes place; 'when', 'at the time'.
n4-068.usageNote: Non-past form of とき - not a different register, just a different verb tense.

n4-011.title: Noun の 間に
n4-011.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'during' a specific period or time.

n4-036.title: Verb ている間に
n4-036.formation: Verb-て form + いる + 間に
n4-036.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'during the time' something is happening.
n4-036.usageNote: "While (an ongoing action continues)" - pairs with an ongoing verb.

n4-115.title: ～までに
n4-115.formation: Verb-casual + までに, Noun + までに, Time expression + までに
n4-115.shortExplanation: Express 'by' or 'before' a certain time or action.
n4-115.usageNote: The standard way to mark a deadline - "by (a time)".

n4-019.title: Noun + 中
n4-019.shortExplanation: Express 'in the middle of', 'during', or 'in the process of'.
n4-019.usageNote: Attaches directly to a noun (e.g. 食事中 "during a meal") - "in the middle of/during".
n4-019.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)

n4-035.title: Verb て いる ところ
n4-035.formation: Verb-て form + いる ところ
n4-035.shortExplanation: Describes an action that is currently happening; 'in the middle of', 'in the process of'.
n4-035.usageNote: "In the middle of doing X" - pairs with an ongoing action verb, more explicit than bare ところ.
n4-035.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)

n4-024.title: Verb た ところ
n4-024.shortExplanation: Expresses the situation right after an action has taken place.
n4-024.usageNote: た + ところ: have just done it (今帰ったところ). In the middle: ているところ. Both use the noun ところ, on opposite sides of the action: Verb-た + ところ is the moment just after it ('upon doing', 'right after'), Verb-dictionary + ところ is the moment just before or during it ('about to', 'in the middle of').
n4-024.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)

n4-054.title: Verb ながら
n4-054.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'as' in the sense of doing two things simultaneously.
n4-054.usageNote: The everyday "while doing X" for two simultaneous actions.

n2-075.title: ～つつ
n2-075.shortExplanation: Shows two actions happening simultaneously or a contrast; 'while', 'although'.
n2-075.usageNote: Literary version of ながら; can also carry a contrastive nuance ("while, even though").

n4-070.title: Verb 出す
n4-070.shortExplanation: Express the action of taking something out, starting an action, or emphasizing a verb.
n4-070.usageNote: ます stem + 出す: suddenly start (泣き出す).
n4-070.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)

n4-072.title: Verb 終わる
n4-072.shortExplanation: Verbal action is completed; 'to finish', 'to end'.
n4-072.usageNote: ます stem + 終わる: finish doing (読み終わる).
n4-072.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)

n4-073.title: Verb + 続ける
n4-073.shortExplanation: To continue doing or to keep doing an action.
n4-073.usageNote: ます stem + 続ける: keep doing (歩き続ける).
n4-073.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)

n4-056.title: Verb にくい
n4-056.shortExplanation: Express difficulty or complexity; 'hard to', 'difficult to', 'not easily'.
n4-056.usageNote: ます stem + にくい: hard to do (読みにくい). Easy to do: やすい.

n4-057.title: Verb やすい
n4-057.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is easy to do; 'easy to', 'easy for'.
n4-057.usageNote: ます stem + やすい: easy to do (読みやすい). Hard to do: にくい.

n4-082.title: ～すぎる
n4-082.formation: Verb-stem + すぎる, い-Adjective (remove い) + すぎる, な-Adjective + すぎる
n4-082.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is excessive or overdone; 'too much', 'too', 'over'.

n4-071.title: Verb 方
n4-071.shortExplanation: Indicates the way or method of doing something; often read as '～かた' ('how to', 'the way of').
n4-071.usageNote: ます stem + 方: how to, the way of (読み方, 作り方).

n4-002.title: A は B ほど～ありません
n4-002.formation: A は B ほど Verb/adjective ありません
n4-002.shortExplanation: Express that A is not as much as B; 'not as... as', 'not... to the extent of'.
n4-002.usageNote: 'A is not as ~ as B': ほど always takes a negative predicate.

n4-007.title: Noun しか～ない
n4-007.usageNote: Paired with a negative verb for emphasis - "nothing but/only", stronger than だけ.

n4-012.title: Noun ばかり
n4-012.formation: Noun + ばかり, Verb-casual + ばかり, い-Adjective + ばかり, な-Adjective + だ ばかり
n4-012.usageNote: Often implies excess or repetition - "always doing X/nothing but X" - can sound like a complaint. (Near-duplicate of n3-087 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

n4-114.title: ～まで
n4-114.formation: Verb + まで, い-Adjective + まで, な-Adjective + まで, Noun + まで
n4-114.usageNote: Casual-to-neutral "even/to the point of" - overlaps with さえ in everyday speech.

n4-005.title: い-Adjective く する/なる
n4-005.formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + く + する/なる
n4-005.shortExplanation: Express a change happening or making something change.
n4-005.usageNote: する: you make it so (明るくする). なる: it became so (赤くなる).

n4-006.title: な-adjective に する/なる
n4-006.formation: な-Adjective + に + する/なる
n4-006.shortExplanation: Used to indicate change or decision; 'to become' or 'to make' with na-adjectives.
n4-006.usageNote: する: you make it so (きれいにする). なる: it became so (元気になる).

n4-051.title: Verb ない + ことにする
n4-051.formation: Verb-ない form + ことにする
n4-051.shortExplanation: To decide not to do something.
n4-051.usageNote: 'Decide not to' (食べないことにした): your own decision.

n4-052.title: Verb ない ことになる
n4-052.shortExplanation: Expresses a result; 'end up not', 'it will become that', 'it would mean that'.
n4-052.usageNote: 'It has been decided that ~ not', by others or by circumstance.

n4-066.title: Verb ることにする
n4-066.shortExplanation: Decide to do something, make a decision.
n4-066.usageNote: ことにする: YOU decide (行くことにした). Decided for you: ことになる.

n4-067.title: Verb る ことになる
n4-067.shortExplanation: Indicates that something has been decided or arranged; 'it has been decided that', 'it turns out that'.
n4-067.usageNote: ことになる: it was decided or arranged, not by you (転勤することになった).

n4-097.title: ～ても/でも
n4-097.formation: Verb-て-form + も, い-Adjective (-い) + くても, な-Adjective + でも, Noun + でも
n4-097.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even if' or 'even though'; used to convey contradiction or contrast.
n4-097.usageNote: "Even if" - a hypothetical/conditional even-though, not a factual contrast. Distinguish from the others, which describe something already true.

n4-116.title: ～まま
n4-116.formation: Verb-た form + まま, Adjective (い & な) + まま, Noun + のまま
n4-116.usageNote: まま: in an unchanged state (靴のまま入る, ドアを開けたまま).
n4-116.familyName: Left As It Is (As Is / Left Undone)

n4-085.title: そんな (sonna) + Noun
n4-085.shortExplanation: Expresses 'that kind/type of'; referring to something near the listener or previously mentioned.
n4-085.usageNote: 'That kind of' (そんな人): points back to something, not a question.
n4-085.familyName: What Kind (What Kind Of / That Kind Of)

n4-086.title: そんなに～
n4-086.formation: そんなに + Verb-negation, そんなに + Adjective-negation
n4-086.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not so much', 'not that', or 'not so ~'.
n4-086.usageNote: 'Not that much': negates a degree someone expected (そんなに高くない).
n4-086.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n4-045.title: Verb て ほしい
n4-045.shortExplanation: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want (someone) to'.
n4-045.usageNote: てほしい: want SOMEONE ELSE to do it (早く来てほしい).
n4-045.familyName: Wanting (Want / Want To / Want Someone To)

n4-121.title: 文A。そのうえ 文B。
n4-121.formation: Sentence A + そのうえ + Sentence B + 。
n4-121.usageNote: Neutral "on top of that". (Same word as n3-001's その上, kana-written; taught at N4.)

n4-122.title: 文A。それで 文B
n4-122.shortExplanation: Used to connect two sentences; 'So', 'That's why', 'Therefore'.
n4-122.usageNote: Casual "and then/so" - conversational, often prompts the listener for what happened next. (Near-duplicate of n2-011's それで, sentence-initial form.)

n4-123.title: 文A。それに 文B
n4-123.formation: Sentence A + それに + Sentence B
n4-123.shortExplanation: Express 'in addition to; besides,' used to include additional information.
n4-123.usageNote: Everyday 'besides, on top of that', in speech; adds another reason or point.

n4-001.title: A とか B とか
n4-001.formation: Noun + とか + Noun + とか
n4-001.shortExplanation: Used to express multiple examples or possibilities; 'such as', 'like', 'for example'.
n4-001.usageNote: Casual, spoken "such as/or something". (Near-duplicate pattern of n2-094's とか, doubled for two examples.)

n2-120.title: ～に先立ち
n2-120.formation: Noun + に先立ち / Verb-dictionary form + に先立って
n2-120.shortExplanation: Express an action or event that occurs before another; 'before', 'prior to', 'preceding'.
n2-120.usageNote: Formal, literary "prior to" - similar register to に先駆けて, common in formal announcements.

n1-065.title: Noun に先駆けて
n1-065.usageNote: Formal, literary "ahead of/in advance of" - announcements, official events.

n3-067.title: ～として
n3-067.formation: Verb-casual + として, い-Adjective + として, な-Adjective + だとして, Noun + だとして
n3-067.shortExplanation: Indicates a role, capacity, or identity; 'as', 'in the capacity of'.

n2-167.title: ～を～として
n2-167.formation: Noun1 + を + Noun2 + として
n2-167.shortExplanation: Express 'as', 'in the capacity of', or 'taking something as...'.
n2-167.usageNote: The everyday "as/in the capacity of", with を explicitly marking the treated-as object.

n3-020.title: ～ことはない
n3-020.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことはない, い-Adjective + ことはない, な-Adjective + であることはない, Noun + であることはない
n3-020.shortExplanation: Expresses that something doesn't need to be done or there's no occasion to do it; 'don't have to', 'not necessary'.
n3-020.usageNote: The everyday "there's no need to/no occasion to".

n1-165.title: Verbる にはあたらない
n1-165.formation: Verb-dictionary form + にはあたらない
n1-165.shortExplanation: Used to say 'there is no need to...', 'it’s not necessary to...'.
n1-165.usageNote: Formal, literary "there's no need to/it's not necessary to".

n1-172.title: Verbる までもない
n1-172.shortExplanation: It's not necessary to the extent of; no need to.
n1-172.usageNote: Formal, literary "not necessary to the extent of".

n1-219.title: ～には及ばない
n1-219.formation: Verb-dictionary form + には及ばない
n1-219.shortExplanation: Means 'no need to go that far' or 'not necessary'.
n1-219.usageNote: Formal, literary "no need to go that far".

n2-106.title: ～にあたり
n2-106.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'at the time of', 'in', 'on', or 'upon'.
n2-106.usageNote: Formal "at the time of/in undertaking X" - formal announcements, ceremonies.
n2-106.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n2-106.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n2-131.title: ～に際して
n2-131.shortExplanation: Used to express the moment or the occasion of an action; 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when'.
n2-131.usageNote: Formal "on the occasion of/at the time of" - common in speeches, formal announcements.
n2-131.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n2-131.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n2-184.title: ～折には
n2-184.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 折には, Verb-た form + 折には, い-Adjective + 折には, な-Adjective + な折には, Noun + の折には
n2-184.shortExplanation: Expresses 'when' or 'in case of' specific situations or timings.
n2-184.usageNote: Formal, literary, ceremonial "on the occasion of". (Near-duplicate of n1-240's 折に, with は added.)
n2-184.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n2-184.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n2-191.title: ～際に
n2-191.formation: Verb-casual + 際に, い-Adjective + 際に, な-Adjective + な際に, Noun + の際に
n2-191.shortExplanation: Means 'when', 'while', or 'on the occasion of' a certain event or situation.
n2-191.usageNote: Neutral, the everyday marker for an occasion or event - "on the occasion of/when".
n2-191.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n2-191.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n1-016.title: Noun かたがた
n1-016.shortExplanation: Do one thing while also doing another; 'while', 'and at the same time'.
n1-016.usageNote: Formal, literary "while also doing/for the purpose of" - similar function to がてら, more formal register.
n1-016.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n1-016.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n1-017.title: Noun がてら
n1-017.shortExplanation: Means 'while...at the same time', 'on the occasion of', or 'along with'.
n1-017.usageNote: Formal, literary "while...at the same time" - doing a second thing incidentally during the first.
n1-017.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
n1-017.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

n2-030.title: Noun を はじめとして
n2-030.usageNote: The common, everyday "starting with/including". (Grammatical variant of n2-029's をはじめ.)

n2-031.title: Noun を はじめとする Noun
n2-031.romaji: Noun o hajime to suru Noun
n2-031.formation: Noun1 を はじめとする Noun2
n2-031.shortExplanation: Indicates a representative example of a group; 'starting with', 'including', 'such as'.
n2-031.usageNote: The common, everyday "starting with/including", attributive form modifying a following noun. (Grammatical variant of n2-029's をはじめ.)

n1-105.title: Noun を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
n1-105.romaji: Noun wo kawakiri ni / wo kawakiri ni shite
n1-105.formation: Noun + を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
n1-105.shortExplanation: Used to indicate the starting point of some series of events or actions; 'starting with', 'beginning with'.
n1-105.usageNote: Formal, literary "starting with" - marks the first in an impressive/escalating series.

n3-004.title: ～おかげで
n3-004.formation: Verb-casual + おかげで, い-Adjective + おかげで, な-Adjective + だおかげで, Noun + のおかげで
n3-004.shortExplanation: Expresses gratitude or shows a positive result due to a certain factor; 'thanks to', 'because of'.
n3-004.usageNote: Implies a positive/grateful outcome - "thanks to X" - unlike the other causality markers, this one always frames the cause favorably.

n3-127.title: ～んだもん
n3-127.formation: Verb-casual + んだもん, い-Adjective + んだもん, な-Adjective + なんだもん, Noun + なんだもん
n3-127.shortExplanation: Used to convey a sense of justification; 'because', 'that's why', 'it's just that'.
n3-127.usageNote: Very casual, whiny/pouty justification; strongly associated with children or exaggerated pouting for effect.

n3-011.title: ～くせに
n3-011.formation: Verb-casual + くせに, い-Adjective + くせに, な-Adjective + な/のくせに, Noun + のくせに
n3-011.shortExplanation: Used to express criticism or disapproval; 'even though', 'despite', 'in spite of'.
n3-011.usageNote: Carries criticism/disdain - "even though X, (which makes Y worse/hypocritical)". Never neutral; always judgmental.

n3-060.title: ～といっても
n3-060.formation: Verb-casual + といっても, い-Adjective + といっても, な-Adjective + だといっても, Noun + だといっても
n3-060.usageNote: "Even though X is true, don't over-assume" - tempers/qualifies a preceding statement, not a plain contrast.

n3-063.title: ～ところが
n3-063.formation: Phrase 1 (expected situation) + ところが + Phrase 2 (unexpected result)
n3-063.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or unexpected outcome; 'however', 'but', 'even though'.
n3-063.usageNote: Introduces an unexpected/surprising outcome; storytelling register, implies surprise rather than plain contrast.

n3-125.title: ～わりには
n3-125.formation: Verb-casual + わりには, い-Adjective + わりには, な-Adjective + だわりには, Noun + だわりには
n3-125.shortExplanation: Expresses contrast between expectation and reality; 'despite', 'considering', 'even though'.
n3-125.usageNote: "Despite X, less/more than expected" - a comparison against expectation, not a plain contrast.

n3-107.title: もし～たなら
n3-107.formation: もし + Verb-casual past + なら, もし + い-Adjective-casual past + なら, もし + な-Adjective + だったなら, もし + Noun + だったなら
n3-107.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical condition, 'if' or 'in case'.
n3-107.usageNote: The everyday "if" - もし signals a hypothetical up front.

n3-109.title: もしも～なら
n3-109.formation: Verb-casual + なら, い-Adjective + なら, な-Adjective + なら, Noun + なら
n3-109.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical condition or situation; 'if', 'in case', 'suppose'.
n3-109.usageNote: Slightly more emphatic version of もし～たなら.

n3-035.title: ～たとえ～ても
n3-035.formation: たとえ + Verb-casual + ても, たとえ + い-Adjective + くても, たとえ + な-Adjective + であっても, たとえ + Noun + であっても
n3-035.shortExplanation: Express a condition with 'even if'; 'no matter how'.
n3-035.usageNote: The standard "even if" - pairs たとえ with ても for emphasis.

n3-069.title: どんなに～ても
n3-069.formation: どんなに + Verb-てform + も, どんなに + い-Adjective-てform + も, どんなに + な-Adjective + でも
n3-069.shortExplanation: Expresses 'no matter how much' or 'even if'; emphasizes the degree of a situation.
n3-069.usageNote: "No matter how much" - emphasizes degree, not just possibility.

n3-078.title: ～にしても
n3-078.formation: Verb-casual + にしても, い-Adjective + にしても, な-Adjective + だにしても, Noun + だにしても
n3-078.usageNote: "Even granting/regardless of" - softer, more conversational than たとえ～ても.

n3-108.title: もし～ても
n3-108.formation: もし + Verb-て form + も / もし + い-Adjective(く) + ても / もし + な-Adjective/Noun + でも
n3-108.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical situation or assumption with the nuance of 'even if'.
n3-108.usageNote: Pairs もし with ても - a plain hypothetical "even if".

n3-023.title: ～しかない
n3-023.formation: Verb-casual + しかない, い-Adjective + しかない, な-Adjective + しかない, Noun + しかない
n3-023.shortExplanation: Express the idea of 'only', 'no other option but', 'nothing else but'.
n3-023.usageNote: "No other option but" - emphasizes lack of alternatives, not just restriction.

n3-032.title: ～だけしか
n3-032.formation: Noun/Quantity + だけ + しか + Negative Verb
n3-032.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the scarcity or insufficiency of something; 'only', 'nothing but'.
n3-032.usageNote: Combines だけ+しか for extra emphasis on the restriction - "only, and nothing else".

n3-055.title: ～ということだ
n3-055.formation: Verb-casual + ということだ, い-Adjective + ということだ, な-Adjective + だということだ, Noun + だということだ
n3-055.shortExplanation: Express a conclusion or hearsay; 'I heard', 'it means', 'it can be said'.
n3-055.usageNote: Hearsay - "I heard that/it's said that" - similar to らしい but frames it as a direct report.

n3-106.title: もしかすると〜かもしれない
n3-106.formation: もしかすると + Sentence + かもしれない
n3-106.usageNote: Slightly more deliberate/emphasized version of かもしれない, often introducing a surprising possibility.

n3-118.title: ～らしい
n3-118.formation: Verb-casual + らしい, い-Adjective + らしい, な-Adjective + だらしい, Noun + だらしい
n3-118.usageNote: Hearsay-based - "I heard that/apparently", based on external information rather than personal judgment.

n3-009.title: ～かわりに
n3-009.formation: Verb-casual + かわりに, い-Adjective + かわりに, な-Adjective + だかわりに, Noun + だかわりに
n3-009.shortExplanation: In place of; instead of; as a substitute for.
n3-009.usageNote: Neutral, flexible "instead of" - can follow a verb phrase ("instead of doing X, I did Y").

n3-076.title: ～にかわって
n3-076.shortExplanation: Expresses 'in place of', 'on behalf of', or 'instead of'.
n3-076.usageNote: Formal "on behalf of/in place of" - noun-only, typically for substituting people/entities.

n3-024.title: すこしも〜ない
n3-024.shortExplanation: Express a negative state or action; 'not at all', 'none whatsoever'.
n3-024.usageNote: "Not even a little" - a slightly more deliberate way to deny completely.
n3-024.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)
n3-024.chapterTitle: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n3-132.title: 決して～ない
n3-132.shortExplanation: Express 'never', 'by no means', or 'not at all' when negating a statement.
n3-132.usageNote: Emphatic "never/by no means" - stronger and more deliberate than ぜんぜん; common in writing and serious statements.
n3-132.familyName: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)
n3-132.chapterTitle: Negation Intensity (Not Very / Not At All)

n3-016.title: ～ことだ
n3-016.formation: Verb-ますstem + ことだ, い-Adjective + ことだ, な-Adjective + なことだ, Noun + のことだ
n3-016.shortExplanation: Expresses advice or recommendation; 'should', 'it is important', 'it is necessary'.
n3-016.usageNote: Neutral, direct advice - "you should.../it's important to...".

n3-089.title: ～はずだ
n3-089.formation: Verb-casual + はずだ, い-Adjective + はずだ, な-Adjective + なはずだ, Noun + のはずだ
n3-089.shortExplanation: Expresses an expectation, 'should' or 'it is supposed to'.
n3-089.usageNote: Expresses an expectation based on reasoning, not advice - "it should be the case that...".

n3-041.title: ～ついでに
n3-041.formation: Verb (dictionary or た-form) + ついでに, Noun + の + ついでに, or Verb-て form + いる + ついでに
n3-041.shortExplanation: Do something while or after completing another action; 'while', 'by the way'.
n3-041.usageNote: "While I'm at it" - doing something extra alongside the main action, not purely a topic shift.

n3-065.title: ところで
n3-065.formation: ところで + new topic or question
n3-065.shortExplanation: Used for changing the topic or bringing up a new topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of'.
n3-065.usageNote: The standard, most common "by the way" topic-change marker.

n3-002.title: ～うちに
n3-002.formation: Verb-てform + いる + うちに, い-Adjective + い + うちに, な-Adjective + な + うちに
n3-002.shortExplanation: Express 'while', 'before', or 'during' a certain condition or situation.
n3-002.usageNote: "While (a temporary condition holds)" - implies acting before the window closes. (Near-duplicate of n2-040 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-002.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-005.title: ～かけ
n3-005.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of being in the middle of doing something or of something being partway done.
n3-005.usageNote: ます stem + かけ: half done, left unfinished (読みかけの本).
n3-005.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)
n3-005.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-034.title: ～たて
n3-034.shortExplanation: Indicates an action that has just been completed; 'freshly', 'just'.
n3-034.usageNote: ます stem + たて: freshly done, just made (焼きたてのパン).
n3-034.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)
n3-034.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-037.title: ～たとたん
n3-037.shortExplanation: Express the moment something happens; 'as soon as', 'the moment', 'the instant'.
n3-037.usageNote: Neutral, emphasizes the immediacy/suddenness of what follows. (Near-duplicate of n2-072 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-037.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-038.title: ～たびに
n3-038.formation: Verb-dictionary form + たびに, Noun + のたびに
n3-038.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-064.title: ～ところだった
n3-064.formation: Verb (dictionary form or ている form) + ところだった
n3-064.shortExplanation: Expresses a near miss or a situation that almost happened; 'was just about to', 'almost', 'nearly'.
n3-064.usageNote: "Was just about to (but didn't)" - a near-miss, describes something that almost happened.
n3-064.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-131.title: ～最中に
n3-131.formation: Verb-て form + いる + 最中に, Noun + の + 最中に
n3-131.shortExplanation: In the middle of / while doing something.
n3-131.usageNote: ている + 最中に: right in the middle of, usually when interrupted.
n3-131.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)
n3-131.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-008.title: ～から～にかけて
n3-008.formation: Noun (time, place, or measure) + から + Noun (time, place or measure) + にかけて
n3-008.shortExplanation: Expresses a range of something, such as time or space; 'from...to', 'between'.
n3-008.usageNote: "From X to Y (roughly, over a span)". (Near-duplicate of n2-055 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-008.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-010.title: ～きり
n3-010.formation: Verb-past + きり, Verb-てform + きり (less common), Noun + きり
n3-010.usageNote: "Only/since then" - a one-time event with a lasting effect, similar to たきり but broader (also means "only").
n3-010.chapterTitle: Windows of time and the moment something happens

n3-003.title: ～うとした
n3-003.shortExplanation: Express an action someone tried to do but couldn't; 'tried to', 'attempted to'.
n3-003.usageNote: Volitional + とした: tried to, often without succeeding (出ようとしたが).
