n3-003.familyName: Trying (Try Doing / Try To / Refuse To)
n3-003.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-110.title: ～ようとしない
n3-110.shortExplanation: Not showing any sign or intention to do something.
n3-110.usageNote: Volitional + としない: won't even try, refuses (謝ろうとしない).
n3-110.familyName: Trying (Try Doing / Try To / Refuse To)
n3-110.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-040.title: ～ちゃった
n3-040.formation: Verb-て/で form -> ちゃった/じゃった (e.g. 食べてしまった -> 食べちゃった)
n3-040.shortExplanation: Express an unintentional action or a regretful action; 'ended up doing', 'did accidentally'.
n3-040.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-128.title: ～上げる
n3-128.shortExplanation: Indicates to finish doing something completely.
n3-128.usageNote: ます stem + 上げる: finish off completely (書き上げる).
n3-128.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)
n3-128.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-129.title: ～切れない
n3-129.shortExplanation: Expresses inability to completely finish or do something.
n3-129.usageNote: ます stem + 切れない: can't do it all (食べ切れない).
n3-129.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)
n3-129.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-044.title: ～っぱなし
n3-044.shortExplanation: Indicate a state where an action is left as is (unchanged or unfinished).
n3-044.usageNote: ます stem + っぱなし: left that way, carelessly not undone (開けっぱなし).
n3-044.familyName: Left As It Is (As Is / Left Undone)
n3-044.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-043.title: ～っぱい
n3-043.formation: Noun + で + いっぱい (Note: written as いっぱい, read as 'ippai')
n3-043.shortExplanation: Expresses fullness or completeness; 'full', 'full of', 'filled with'.
n3-043.usageNote: いっぱい: full of (荷物でいっぱい).
n3-043.chapterTitle: Trying, finishing, and leaving things as they are

n3-007.title: ～ないで
n3-007.usageNote: ないで: without doing (朝ご飯を食べないで出かけた). Not a reason: なくて.
n3-007.chapterTitle: Without doing, and degrees of denial

n3-025.title: ～ずに
n3-025.formation: Verb-ない form (Remove ない) + ずに
n3-025.shortExplanation: Express 'without doing' something or 'not doing' something.
n3-025.chapterTitle: Without doing, and degrees of denial

n3-104.title: ～めったに～ない
n3-104.formation: めったに + Verb[ない-form] / めったに + い-Adjective[ない-form] / めったに + な-Adjective[じゃない/ではない-form]
n3-104.shortExplanation: Used to express that something rarely, hardly ever or seldom happens.
n3-104.usageNote: めったに～ない: rarely, hardly ever (めったに外食しない).
n3-104.chapterTitle: Without doing, and degrees of denial

n3-070.title: ～ないことはない
n3-070.formation: Verb-ない form + ことはない
n3-070.shortExplanation: Express the idea that 'it's not that it's impossible' or 'it's not that it cannot be done'.
n3-070.usageNote: "It's not impossible". (Near-duplicate of n2-102 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-070.chapterTitle: Without doing, and degrees of denial

n3-130.title: 必ずしも～とは限らない
n3-130.formation: 必ずしも + Statement + とは限らない
n3-130.usageNote: "Not always/not necessarily true" - with 必ずしも added up front for emphasis.
n3-130.chapterTitle: Without doing, and degrees of denial

n3-017.title: ～ことにしている
n3-017.shortExplanation: Express a personal rule or habit; 'I make it a rule to', 'I always make sure to'.
n3-017.usageNote: ことにしている: a rule you set yourself and keep (毎朝走ることにしている).

n3-018.title: ～ことになっている
n3-018.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことになっている
n3-018.shortExplanation: Describes something that is decided, arranged, or expected.
n3-018.usageNote: ことになっている: a rule or arrangement set by others (～ことになっている).

n3-115.title: ～ようにしましょう
n3-115.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ようにしましょう / Verb-negative form + ようにしましょう
n3-115.shortExplanation: A suggestion to make an effort or try to do something; 'let's try to', 'let's make sure to'.
n3-115.usageNote: 'Let's make a point of ~': suggests keeping a habit (忘れないようにしましょう).
n3-115.familyName: Effort And Change (Try To / Come To)

n3-116.title: ～ようになった
n3-116.shortExplanation: Express an event or state that became possible; 'became able to', 'started to', 'now can'.
n3-116.usageNote: ようになった: the change is complete now (読めるようになった).
n3-116.familyName: Effort And Change (Try To / Come To)

n3-113.title: ～ように
n3-113.formation: Verb-casual + ように, い-Adjective + ように, な-Adjective + だように, Noun + のように
n3-113.shortExplanation: Used to express a purpose, a way, or a natural tendency.
n3-113.usageNote: ように: so that (a result you can't directly control), or 'like'.

n3-095.title: ～べきだ
n3-095.shortExplanation: Express an obligation or something that should be done (mainly with verbs).
n3-095.usageNote: べきだ: should, ought to; a firm duty or moral judgment (謝るべきだ).

n3-124.title: ～わけにはいかない
n3-124.formation: Verb-casual + わけにはいかない
n3-124.shortExplanation: Expresses that something cannot be allowed or permitted due to social/moral obligations.
n3-124.usageNote: "Cannot/must not do X". (Near-duplicate of n2-165 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

n3-121.title: ～わけがない
n3-121.formation: Verb-casual + わけがない, い-Adjective + わけがない, な-Adjective + なわけがない, Noun + のわけがない
n3-121.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is impossible or unreasonable; 'there's no way', 'can't be'.
n3-121.usageNote: "There's no way/it's impossible". (Near-duplicate of n2-162 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-121.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-122.title: ～わけだ
n3-122.formation: Verb-casual + わけだ, い-Adjective + わけだ, な-Adjective + なわけだ, Noun + のわけだ
n3-122.shortExplanation: Expresses a logical conclusion or reason based on information; 'that's why', 'no wonder', 'it means'.
n3-122.usageNote: "It means/no wonder". (Near-duplicate of n2-163's わけだ - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-122.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-123.title: ～わけではない
n3-123.formation: Verb-casual + わけではない, い-Adjective + わけではない, な-Adjective + だわけではない, Noun + だわけではない
n3-123.shortExplanation: Denies a general assumption; 'it does not mean that', 'it's not the case'.
n3-123.usageNote: "It doesn't mean that/it's not the case that". (Near-duplicate of n2-164 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)
n3-123.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-045.title: ～つまり
n3-045.formation: Sentence A + つまり + Sentence B (rephrasing)
n3-045.shortExplanation: Summarizing, restating, or clarifying a point: 'in other words', 'that is to say'.
n3-045.usageNote: The standard "in other words" - summarizes or restates a point.
n3-045.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-058.title: ～というのは
n3-058.shortExplanation: Used to provide an explanation or definition; 'that is to say...', 'by that, I mean...'.
n3-058.usageNote: というのは: 'what X means is', a definition or explanation.
n3-058.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-056.title: ～というと
n3-056.shortExplanation: Used to provide an example or characteristic related to the topic; 'when it comes to', 'speaking of'.
n3-056.usageNote: "Speaking of/when it comes to" - introduces a related example or characteristic.
n3-056.chapterTitle: Drawing a conclusion, and restating it

n3-014.title: ～こそ
n3-014.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the importance or uniqueness of something or someone; 'precisely', 'exactly', 'it is...', 'of all...'.
n3-014.usageNote: こそ: this very one, and no other (今日こそ).
n3-014.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n3-022.title: ～さえ
n3-022.formation: Noun + さえ, Verb-casual + さえ, い-Adjective + さえ, な-Adjective + でさえ
n3-022.shortExplanation: Emphasizes a specific item or action; 'even', 'if only', 'as long as'.

n3-021.title: ～さ
n3-021.formation: い-Adjective (drop い) + さ, な-Adjective + さ
n3-021.shortExplanation: Express the degree or extent of a quality; '-ness', 'degree of'.

n3-096.title: ～ほど～
n3-096.formation: Verb-casual + ほど, い-Adjective + ほど, な-Adjective + ほど, Noun + ほど
n3-096.shortExplanation: Expresses the degree or extent; 'about', 'to the extent', 'as much as'.
n3-096.usageNote: "To the extent of/as much as" - a comparative degree marker, a distinct construction from くらい/ぐらい but the same approximate-degree idea.

n3-091.title: ～ば～ほど
n3-091.formation: Verb-casual + ば + Verb-casual + ほど, い-Adjective + ば + い-Adjective + ほど, な-Adjective + であれば + な-Adjective + ほど
n3-091.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the more ~, the more ~'; a proportional relationship between two phrases.
n3-091.usageNote: ば～ほど: the more X, the more Y (練習すればするほど).

n3-013.title: ～くらい～は～ない
n3-013.formation: Verb-casual (non-past) + くらい + は + Verb-casual (negative), Adjective (non-past) + くらい + は + Adjective (negative)
n3-013.shortExplanation: Express the least one can do; 'at least', 'the least', 'no less than'.
n3-013.usageNote: "At least this much, surely" - sets a low bar that should be achievable.

n3-068.title: ～どんなに～ことか
n3-068.formation: どんなに + Adjective + ことか, どんなに + Verb + ことか
n3-068.shortExplanation: Expresses the extent of something or emphasizes the degree of a condition or situation.
n3-068.usageNote: どんなに～ことか: how very (どんなに嬉しかったことか).

n3-026.title: ～せいで
n3-026.formation: Verb-casual + せいで, い-Adjective + せいで, な-Adjective + なせいで, Noun + のせいで
n3-026.shortExplanation: Indicates that something or someone caused an unfortunate result.
n3-026.usageNote: せいで: because of, blaming the cause for a bad result. Good result: おかげで.

n3-028.title: ～そのために
n3-028.shortExplanation: For the purpose of; because of; in order to.
n3-028.usageNote: そのために: for that purpose, or because of that (sentence-initial).

n3-029.title: ～その結果
n3-029.shortExplanation: Shows the result or consequence of a previous action or situation; 'as a result', 'in consequence'.
n3-029.usageNote: その結果: as a result of that (sentence-initial).

n3-081.title: ～によって
n3-081.formation: Verb-casual + によって, い-Adjective + によって, な-Adjective + によって, Noun + によって
n3-081.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason or cause, difference depending on a factor, or methods used.
n3-081.usageNote: によって: by means of, due to, depending on. Written: により.

n3-066.title: ～としたら
n3-066.formation: Verb-casual + としたら, い-Adjective + としたら, な-Adjective + だとしたら, Noun + だとしたら
n3-066.usageNote: The everyday hypothetical "assuming/if". (Near-duplicate of n2-098 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

n3-090.title: ～ば～のに
n3-090.formation: Verb-ば form + ～のに, い-Adjective-ば form + ～のに, な-Adjective + であれば + ～のに, Noun + であれば + ～のに
n3-090.usageNote: Regretful - "if only X, (but reality is otherwise)".
n3-090.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n3-093.title: ～ばよかった
n3-093.formation: Verb-ば-form + よかった, い-Adjective-く + ばよかった, な-Adjective + ならよかった
n3-093.shortExplanation: Express a sense of regret; 'I wish', 'it would have been better if'.
n3-093.usageNote: ばよかった: 'I should have', regret about the past (行けばよかった).
n3-093.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n3-053.title: ～といいなあ
n3-053.formation: Verb-casual + といいなあ, い-Adjective + といいなあ, な-Adjective + だといいなあ, Noun + だといいなあ
n3-053.shortExplanation: Express a wish or hope; 'it would be nice if', 'I hope that'.
n3-053.usageNote: といいなあ: 'I hope', a hope for something you can't control (晴れるといいなあ).
n3-053.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n3-097.title: ～ますように
n3-097.formation: Verb-ます form, remove final る + ように
n3-097.shortExplanation: Used to express a wish or hope for oneself or someone else.
n3-097.usageNote: ますように: a prayer or wish (合格しますように).
n3-097.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n3-050.title: ～てはじめて
n3-050.shortExplanation: Realization or action done for the first time; 'only after', 'not until'.
n3-050.usageNote: てはじめて: only after doing X did you realize or could (失ってはじめて).

n3-075.title: ～において
n3-075.shortExplanation: Indicates the place, time, or context where an action or situation takes place.
n3-075.usageNote: において: in, at (a place, time or field), in formal writing. Everyday: で.

n3-080.title: ～にとって
n3-080.formation: Noun (person or thing) + にとって + Verb/Adjective/Noun
n3-080.shortExplanation: Express the meaning 'for', 'to', 'from the perspective of'.

n3-082.title: ～によれば
n3-082.usageNote: The everyday way to cite a source - "according to...".

n3-083.title: ～に対して
n3-083.formation: Verb-casual + に対して, い-Adjective + に対して, な-Adjective + に対して, Noun + に対して
n3-083.shortExplanation: Indicates a target or contrast; 'toward', 'against', 'in contrast to', 'in response to'.
n3-083.usageNote: The everyday "toward/regarding" - also used for contrast between two things. (Near-duplicate of n2-123 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

n3-084.title: ～に比べて
n3-084.formation: Verb-casual + に比べて, い-Adjective + に比べて, な-Adjective + だ/である + に比べて, Noun + だ/である + に比べて
n3-084.shortExplanation: Comparing to; in comparison with; as opposed to.
n3-084.usageNote: に比べて: compared with (去年に比べて寒い).

n3-085.title: ～に関して
n3-085.shortExplanation: Regarding, concerning, about, with respect to.
n3-085.usageNote: に関して: regarding, a little more formal than について.

n3-077.title: ～にしては
n3-077.formation: Verb-casual + にしては, い-Adjective + にしては, な-Adjective + にしては, Noun + にしては
n3-077.shortExplanation: Express 'for' or 'considering' in the sense of being unusual or unexpected.
n3-077.usageNote: "For/considering" - used when something is unusual or unexpected given X.

n3-059.title: ～というより
n3-059.formation: Verb-casual + というより, い-Adjective + というより, な-Adjective + だというより, Noun + だというより
n3-059.shortExplanation: Express a comparison with preference; 'rather than', 'more like', 'instead of'.
n3-059.usageNote: というより: rather than A, it is more B (寒いというより痛い).

n3-061.title: ～とおり
n3-061.formation: Verb-casual + とおり, Noun + のとおり
n3-061.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is done 'as is', 'as stated', or 'as instructed'.
n3-061.usageNote: とおり(に): exactly as said or shown (言ったとおりにする).

n3-094.title: ～ふりをする
n3-094.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ふりをする, い-Adjective + ふりをする, な-Adjective + ふりをする, Noun + ふりをする
n3-094.shortExplanation: Pretending or acting as if; 'pretend', 'act like'.
n3-094.usageNote: ふりをする: pretend (知らないふりをする).
n3-094.familyName: Pretending (Pretend To / As If To Say)
n3-094.chapterTitle: How things look, and how they stay

n3-101.title: まるで～よう
n3-101.shortExplanation: Used to express a strong resemblance or similarity; 'as if', 'just like', 'as though'.
n3-101.usageNote: Emphatic "just like/exactly as if" - まるで adds emphasis to an already-strong resemblance.
n3-101.chapterTitle: How things look, and how they stay

n3-119.title: ～られた
n3-119.formation: Verb (passive) + られた, Verb (passive) + れた, Verb (passive) + られました, Verb (passive) + れました
n3-119.usageNote: られた: passive past, 'was done' (騙された).
n3-119.familyName: Causative And Passive (Make / Be Done To / Be Made To)
n3-119.chapterTitle: How things look, and how they stay

n3-042.title: ～っけ？
n3-042.formation: Verb-casual + っけ?, い-Adjective + かったっけ?, な-Adjective/Noun + だっけ?
n3-042.shortExplanation: Used to express that one is trying to recall some information.
n3-042.usageNote: っけ: trying to remember something you once knew (何時だっけ？).

n3-047.title: ～てくれと
n3-047.formation: Verb-て form + くれと (言う / 頼む / 伝える, etc.)
n3-047.shortExplanation: Quote someone's request (telling someone to do something).
n3-047.usageNote: てくれと言う: quotes a direct request, 'told me to' (来てくれと言われた).

n3-048.title: ～てごらん
n3-048.shortExplanation: Suggest or invite someone to try doing something; 'Why don't you try...'.
n3-048.usageNote: てごらん: 'try it and see', said to a child or someone junior.
n3-048.familyName: Trying (Try Doing / Try To / Refuse To)

n3-062.title: ～とく
n3-062.formation: Verb-て form + とく (e.g., 食べておく -> 食べとく, 読んでおく -> 読んどく)
n3-062.shortExplanation: Express doing something in advance or for future convenience (casual form of ～ておく).

n3-031.title: ～？それとも～？
n3-031.usageNote: "Or (alternatively)" - used between two full question options.

n3-046.title: ～つもりでした
n3-046.formation: Verb-casual (dictionary form) + つもりでした
n3-046.shortExplanation: Expressing a past intention or plan; 'was planning to', 'meant to'.
n3-046.usageNote: Past-tense "was planning to/meant to (but didn't necessarily follow through)".

n3-019.title: ～ことは…が
n3-019.formation: Verb-casual + ことは + が, い-Adjective + ことは + が, な-Adjective + だ + ことは + が, Noun + だ + ことは + が
n3-019.shortExplanation: Indicates that while something may be true or valid, there is another contrasting point.
n3-019.usageNote: X ことは X が: it is X, admittedly, but (高いことは高いが).

n3-092.title: ～はもちろん～も
n3-092.formation: Noun1 + はもちろん + Noun2 + も
n3-092.shortExplanation: Used for emphasizing that not only one thing but also another thing is included. It means 'not only... but also' or 'of course... and...'.
n3-092.usageNote: The everyday "not only... but of course also".

n2-178.title: ～以上
n2-178.formation: Verb-casual + 以上, い-Adjective + 以上, な-Adjective + な以上, Noun + の以上
n2-178.shortExplanation: Expresses 'since' or 'as long as' in a conditional context.
n2-178.usageNote: "Given that/since (this is the case), as long as it stands".
n2-178.chapterTitle: N2: As Long As (To That Extent)

n2-190.title: ～限り
n2-190.formation: Verb-casual + 限り, い-Adjective + 限り, な-Adjective + な限り, Noun + の限り
n2-190.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as long as', 'while', or 'to the extent that' a certain condition holds true.
n2-190.usageNote: Neutral, common "as long as/to the extent that".
n2-190.chapterTitle: N2: As Long As (To That Extent)

n2-046.title: ～か～ないかのうちに
n2-046.formation: Verb-casual + か + Verb-negative form + かのうちに
n2-046.shortExplanation: Expresses an action that occurs immediately after another action; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than', 'the moment'.
n2-046.usageNote: Neutral "just as/almost before" - emphasizes the two actions nearly overlapping.
n2-046.chapterTitle: N2: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n2-067.title: ～たかと思ったら
n2-067.formation: Verb-た form + かと思ったら
n2-067.shortExplanation: Express a sequence of events happening in quick succession; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than'.
n2-067.usageNote: Neutral, often carries surprise - "just when I thought..., then...".
n2-067.chapterTitle: N2: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n2-186.title: ～次第
n2-186.formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第, Noun + 次第
n2-186.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as soon as' (when used with Verb-ますstem) or 'depending on' (when used with a noun).
n2-186.usageNote: "As soon as" with a ます-stem verb - a different construction from the others (also separately means "depending on" when attached to a noun).
n2-186.chapterTitle: N2: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n2-065.title: ～ずにはいられない
n2-065.formation: Verb-ない form (drop ない) + ずにはいられない
n2-065.shortExplanation: Cannot help but; cannot resist doing; an irresistible urge.
n2-065.usageNote: "Cannot resist doing/an irresistible urge" - the everyday version of the overwhelming-feeling idea.

n2-079.title: ～ていられない
n2-079.formation: Verb-て form + いられない
n2-079.shortExplanation: Expresses that one cannot afford to do something; 'can't keep on', 'unable to continue'.
n2-079.usageNote: "Can't afford to keep doing X" - describes being unable to continue calmly given the situation.

n2-084.title: ～でたまらない
n2-084.formation: い-Adjective (く) + てたまらない / な-Adjective + でたまらない / Verb-て form + たまらない
n2-084.shortExplanation: Express extremely strong feelings or sensations; 'can't stand', 'unbearably'.
n2-084.usageNote: "Unbearably.../can't stand it" - an intense physical or emotional sensation.

n2-085.title: ～でならない
n2-085.formation: な-Adjective + でならない / い-Adjective (く) + てならない / Verb-て + ならない
n2-085.shortExplanation: Indicates an uncontrollable emotion or feeling; 'can’t help but', 'overwhelmingly'.
n2-085.usageNote: "Can't help but feel.../overwhelmingly" - specifically for an uncontrollable emotion, not an action.

n2-019.title: A。だって B。
n2-019.formation: Verb-casual + だって、い-Adjective + だって、な-Adjective + だって、Noun + だって
n2-019.shortExplanation: Used to give a reason, express cause or bring up a topic; 'because', 'since', 'it's just that'.
n2-019.usageNote: Defensive/childish "because"; typically used to justify oneself, can sound whiny.

n2-139.title: ～ばかりに
n2-139.formation: Verb-casual + ばかりに, い-Adjective + ばかりに, な-Adjective + なばかりに, Noun + なばかりに
n2-139.shortExplanation: Express an undesired situation or result caused by something; 'simply because', 'due to', 'on account of'.
n2-139.usageNote: "Simply because of X, (an unfortunate result followed)" - always frames the cause as leading to a bad outcome.

n2-153.title: ～ものだから
n2-153.formation: Verb-plain + ものだから, い-Adjective + ものだから, な-Adjective + なものだから, Noun + なものだから
n2-153.shortExplanation: Express the reason or cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
n2-153.usageNote: Explains/excuses a reason, often for something slightly unexpected; conversational but not blunt.

n2-013.title: A。それなのに B。
n2-013.shortExplanation: Express contrast or a contradiction between two situations or facts; 'even though', 'despite', 'but still'.
n2-013.usageNote: Similar surprise/frustration nuance to ところが but stronger - often implies the speaker is annoyed or let down.

n2-117.title: ～にもかかわらず
n2-117.formation: Verb (any tense/form) + にもかかわらず, い-Adjective + にもかかわらず, な-Adjective (or Noun) + であるにもかかわらず
n2-117.usageNote: Formal, neutral-toned "despite/in spite of"; safe in writing and polite speech, no built-in criticism.

n2-121.title: ～に反して
n2-121.shortExplanation: Contrary to, against, in spite of
n2-121.usageNote: Formal "contrary to (what was expected)" - the outcome defies the setup.

n2-007.title: A。すると B。
n2-007.shortExplanation: Indicates that when action A is done, action or event B follows; 'then', 'when', 'if'.
n2-007.usageNote: Neutral, everyday "then/if" - describes what naturally follows from an action.

n2-056.title: ～からには
n2-056.formation: Noun + だ + からには, な-Adjective + だ + からには, い-Adjective + からには, Verb-casual + からには
n2-056.shortExplanation: Express a sense of responsibility or determination; 'since', 'now that', 'if'.
n2-056.usageNote: "Now that/since (you've committed to X)" - implies a resulting obligation or determination.

n2-177.title: ～上は
n2-177.formation: Verb-casual + 上は, い-Adjective + 上は, な-Adjective + な上は, Noun + の上は
n2-177.usageNote: "Now that.../since (this is decided)" - similar to からには, implies a resulting commitment.

n2-012.title: A。それでも B。
n2-012.formation: A (situation) + 。それでも + B (action or thought)
n2-012.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even so', 'nevertheless', 'still', or 'but'; used to contrast two statements.
n2-012.usageNote: Stronger than a plain "but" - "even so/nevertheless"; used when the second clause defies what the first would lead you to expect.

n2-017.title: A。ただB。
n2-017.formation: Sentence A + ただ + Sentence B
n2-017.usageNote: Adds a minor reservation or exception to what was just said - "that said..."; softer than a full contrast.

n2-018.title: A。ただしB。
n2-018.formation: Statement A + ただし + Condition B
n2-018.shortExplanation: Adding a condition or exception to a statement; 'however', 'provided that', 'but only if'.
n2-018.usageNote: Formal - introduces a condition or exception to a rule just stated; common in contracts, regulations, instructions.

n2-024.title: A。もっとも B。
n2-024.formation: Clause A + もっとも + Clause B
n2-024.usageNote: Concessive "though, to be fair..." - softens or qualifies a preceding statement rather than flatly contradicting it.

n2-125.title: ～に応じて
n2-125.shortExplanation: In accordance with, depending on, in response to.
n2-125.usageNote: "Depending on/in accordance with" - adjusts based on a varying factor.

n2-187.title: ～次第で
n2-187.shortExplanation: Indicates 'depending on; based on' a certain factor or situation.
n2-187.usageNote: "Depending on X" - the outcome varies based on this factor.

n2-188.title: ～次第です
n2-188.formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第です (or Noun + 次第です)
n2-188.shortExplanation: A polite/formal way to say 'it depends on...' or 'as soon as...', often used in concluding statements.
n2-188.usageNote: Polite/formal "it depends on..." - often used in concluding formal statements.

n2-089.title: ～てまで
n2-089.shortExplanation: Express the extent someone goes in order to achieve something; 'to the point of', 'even', 'so far as to'.
n2-089.usageNote: Emphasizes going to an extreme extent - "even going so far as to...".

n2-147.title: ～まで～て
n2-147.shortExplanation: Express doing something until a certain time or condition; 'until', 'to'.
n2-147.usageNote: Verb-て + まで variant - "(does something) until X happens".

n2-116.title: ～にほかならない
n2-116.formation: Verb-plain + にほかならない, い-Adjective + にほかならない, な-Adjective + にほかならない, Noun + にほかならない
n2-116.shortExplanation: Express that something is 'nothing but' or 'none other than'.
n2-116.usageNote: Emphatic literary "nothing other than" - asserts something is exactly and only this.

n2-128.title: ～に過ぎない
n2-128.formation: Verb-casual + に過ぎない, い-Adjective + に過ぎない, な-Adjective + に過ぎない, Noun + に過ぎない
n2-128.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is 'just' or 'nothing more than'; 'merely', 'only', 'simply'.
n2-128.usageNote: Dismissive "merely/nothing more than" - downplays significance; common in writing and analysis.

n2-130.title: ～に限り
n2-130.usageNote: Administrative "limited to" - common in official rules, offers, terms.

n2-138.title: ～ばかりだ
n2-138.formation: Verb-てform + ばかりだ, い-Adjective + ばかりだ, な-Adjective + ばかりだ, Noun + ばかりだ
n2-138.shortExplanation: Express a continuing state or negative tendency; 'just', 'only', 'always'.
n2-138.usageNote: "Nothing but getting worse/only continuing to..." - describes a one-directional negative trend.

n2-064.title: ～ざるを得ない
n2-064.formation: Verb-ない form (drop ない) + ざるを得ない
n2-064.shortExplanation: Have no choice but to; cannot help but.
n2-064.usageNote: "Have no choice but to/cannot avoid doing" - the more common, less literary version of ざるを得ない.

n2-161.title: ～よりほかない
n2-161.formation: Verb-dictionary form + よりほかない
n2-161.shortExplanation: Express that there is no other choice; 'have no choice but', 'cannot do anything but'.
n2-161.usageNote: "Have no other choice but X" - names the one remaining option explicitly.

n2-133.title: ～のみならず～も
n2-133.formation: Verb-casual + のみならず + (も), い-Adjective + のみならず + (も), な-Adjective + のみならず + (も), Noun + のみならず + (も)
n2-133.shortExplanation: Not only... but also; as well as.
n2-133.usageNote: "Not only... but also" - formal, written register.
n2-133.chapterTitle: N2: Not Only But Also (Emphatic Addition)

n2-137.title: ～ばかりか〜も
n2-137.formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + ばかりか + Noun/Verb/Adjective + も
n2-137.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not only... but also'; emphasizing the extent of something.
n2-137.usageNote: "Not only... but even" - emphasizes the second, often surprising, fact.
n2-137.chapterTitle: N2: Not Only But Also (Emphatic Addition)

n2-057.title: ～から見ると
n2-057.shortExplanation: Express a perspective or point of view; 'from the standpoint of', 'in terms of', 'from the perspective of'.
n2-057.usageNote: Neutral "from the standpoint of/looking at it from...".

n2-058.title: ～から言うと
n2-058.formation: Noun + から言うと (common), [Verb-casual / Adjective + から言って] (less common)
n2-058.shortExplanation: Express a judgment or opinion based on a specific criterion; 'speaking from', 'in terms of', 'from the viewpoint of'.

n2-111.title: ～にしたら
n2-111.formation: Noun + にしたら, Pronoun + にしたら
n2-111.shortExplanation: Express a point of view; 'from the perspective of', 'if I were'.
n2-111.usageNote: Neutral "if you ask.../from (someone)'s perspective" - often used for a third party's viewpoint.

n2-135.title: 〜の上では
n2-135.formation: Noun or Phrase + の上では
n2-135.shortExplanation: Indicates 'on the basis of', 'in terms of', or 'from the standpoint of'.
n2-135.usageNote: Formal "on the basis of/in terms of" - typically for a formal/technical criterion (e.g. "legally speaking").

n2-114.title: ～につれて
n2-114.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + につれて, Noun + につれて
n2-114.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that as one thing changes, so does another; 'as', 'along with', 'while'.
n2-114.usageNote: "As X changes, so does Y" - describes two related changes happening together.
n2-114.chapterTitle: N2: Proportional Change (As X, So Y)

n2-115.title: ～にともなって
n2-115.formation: Noun (event) + にともなって, Verb-casual + にともなって
n2-115.shortExplanation: Expresses 'along with' or 'as a result of'; indicates that one event occurs along with another.
n2-115.usageNote: "Along with/as a result of" - similar proportional-change sense to につれて, slightly more formal.
n2-115.chapterTitle: N2: Proportional Change (As X, So Y)

n2-026.title: Noun につき
n2-026.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason, cause, or condition for something; 'due to', 'regarding', 'per'.

n2-033.title: Noun を めぐる Noun
n2-033.formation: Noun1 + を + めぐる + Noun2
n2-033.shortExplanation: Indicate a situation or event revolving around a particular noun; 'concerning', 'regarding', 'pertaining to'.
n2-033.usageNote: "Revolving around/concerning" - typically a debate, dispute, or complex topic.

n2-129.title: ～に関わって
n2-129.formation: Verb-casual + に関わって, い-Adjective + に関わって, な-Adjective + に関わって, Noun + に関わって
n2-129.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is related to or influenced by a certain matter or factor; 'concerning', 'in connection with', 'regarding'.

n2-001.title: A あるいは B
n2-001.formation: Phrase A + あるいは + Phrase B
n2-001.shortExplanation: Indicates alternatives; 'A or B', 'either A or B'.
n2-001.usageNote: Neutral, plain "or" - the everyday conjunction, not the literary A-とも-B-とも pattern.

n2-112.title: ～にしろ～にしろ
n2-112.formation: Verb (dictionary form or negative form) + にしろ, い-Adjective + にしろ, な-Adjective + にしろ, Noun + にしろ
n2-112.shortExplanation: Expresses 'either way', 'in any case', 'be it...', used when presenting two alternatives.
n2-112.usageNote: Neutral "either way/in any case" - the everyday version of the whether-A-or-B pattern, less literary than the N1 forms.

n2-108.title: ～にかかわらず
n2-108.formation: Verb-dictionary form + にかかわらず, い-Adjective + にかかわらず, な-Adjective + にかかわらず, Noun + にかかわらず
n2-108.shortExplanation: Regardless of; irrespective of; (often used as) 'whether or not'.
n2-108.usageNote: Neutral "regardless of/irrespective of" - the everyday version, less formal than the N1 forms.

n2-169.title: ～を問わず
n2-169.usageNote: Formal "regardless of/irrespective of" - common in official contexts (e.g. job postings: "regardless of experience").

n2-047.title: ～かねない
n2-047.shortExplanation: Express the likelihood of a negative outcome or consequence.
n2-047.usageNote: "Might result in (a negative outcome)" - a warning about a possible bad consequence.

n2-183.title: ～恐れがある
n2-183.shortExplanation: Express a concern or fear that something undesirable might occur.
n2-183.usageNote: Formal "there is a risk/concern that..." - written, cautionary register.

n2-038.title: ～あげく
n2-038.formation: Verb-た + あげく / Noun + の + あげく
n2-038.shortExplanation: Expresses the outcome of a series of actions or events; 'in the end', 'finally', 'after'.
n2-038.usageNote: Often a negative outcome - "after all that, (unfortunately)...".

n2-068.title: ～たきり
n2-068.shortExplanation: Express 'since then' or 'after'; used to indicate that an action occurred once and has not been repeated or that a state has continued since a certain event or time.
n2-068.usageNote: "Since then, X hasn't happened again" - marks a one-time event with no follow-up.

n2-175.title: ～上で
n2-175.formation: Verb-ますstem + 上で, Noun + の上で
n2-175.shortExplanation: Used to express that something is done after or on the basis of something else; 'after', 'upon'.
n2-175.usageNote: "After doing X, on that basis" - the next step builds on the first.

n2-179.title: ～以来
n2-179.formation: Verb-past + 以来, い-Adjective + 以来, Noun + 以来
n2-179.shortExplanation: Indicates something happening 'since', 'ever since', or 'after' a particular time.
n2-179.usageNote: Formal, written "ever since" - marks a lasting change since a point in time.

n2-185.title: ～末
n2-185.shortExplanation: Express the outcome after a period of time or series of actions; 'after', 'as a result of'.
n2-185.usageNote: Formal, written "after (a long process), finally" - emphasizes the effort/duration before the outcome.

n2-005.title: A。したがって B。
n2-005.usageNote: Formal, literary "therefore/consequently" - written, academic, or formal speech.

n2-009.title: A。そこで B。
n2-009.usageNote: "So, at that point" - narrative, marks the next logical step in a story.

n2-118.title: ～により
n2-118.formation: Noun + により, Verb + により
n2-118.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason, method, or means by which something happens; 'by', 'through', 'due to'.
n2-118.usageNote: Formal "by means of/due to" - method or cause, common in formal/written contexts.

n2-119.title: ～にわたって
n2-119.usageNote: Formal "over/across (a range)" - typically time or scope.

n2-171.title: ～を通じて
n2-171.usageNote: Formal "through/throughout" - a channel or period something happens via/across.

n2-003.title: A。さて B。
n2-003.shortExplanation: Indicates a sudden change or shift in the topic or situation; 'now then', 'well', 'so'.
n2-003.usageNote: "Well then/now" - a deliberate shift to a new topic or phase.

n2-008.title: A。そういえば B。
n2-008.shortExplanation: Recalling something related to A; 'speaking of which', 'by the way', 'now that you mention it'.
n2-008.usageNote: Casual "speaking of which" - triggered by something reminding the speaker of a related topic.

n2-015.title: A それはそうと B。
n2-015.romaji: A Sore wa sou to B
n2-015.formation: Sentence A + それはそうと + Sentence B
n2-015.shortExplanation: Changing the topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of which'.
n2-015.usageNote: "By the way" as a deliberate topic change.

n2-020.title: A。ちなみに B。
n2-020.shortExplanation: Used to give additional information about the topic; 'by the way', 'incidentally'.
n2-020.usageNote: Formal-leaning "incidentally" - adds a related side note, common in writing too.

n2-066.title: ～そうにない
n2-066.formation: Verb-stem + そうにない / い-Adjective (drop い) + そうにない / な-Adjective + そうにない
n2-066.shortExplanation: Express the unlikelihood of something happening; 'not likely', 'doesn't seem'.
n2-066.usageNote: "Doesn't seem likely to happen". (Near-duplicate of n1-122 - same construction, taught at both N1 and N2.)

n2-074.title: ～っこない
n2-074.shortExplanation: Expresses the impossibility or very low probability of something happening; 'no way', 'impossible'.

n2-150.title: ～ものか
n2-150.formation: Verb-casual + ものか, い-Adjective + ものか, な-Adjective + (な)ものか, Noun + (な)ものか
n2-150.shortExplanation: Definitely not; no way; no chance.
n2-150.usageNote: Rhetorical "no way/definitely not" - a strong denial phrased as a question.

n2-160.title: ～ようがない
n2-160.formation: Verb-ます stem + ようがない
n2-160.shortExplanation: Expresses that there is no way (method) to do something; it's impossible to do.
n2-160.usageNote: "There's no way to do X". (Near-duplicate of n1-150 - same construction, taught at both N1 and N2.)

n2-063.title: ～さえ～ば
n2-063.formation: Noun + さえ + Verb-conditional / Verb-ますstem + さえすれば / etc. (varies by part of speech)
n2-063.shortExplanation: Expresses that, as long as a certain condition is met, something else will follow; 'if only', 'provided that'.
n2-063.usageNote: "If only X, then Y would follow" - a conditional wish, not necessarily regretful.
n2-063.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)
n2-063.chapterTitle: N2: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n2-155.title: ～ものなら
n2-155.formation: Verb-(potential/plain) form + ものなら, etc.
n2-155.shortExplanation: Expresses a conditional wish or unlikely possibility; 'if only', 'if it were possible'.
n2-155.usageNote: A wishful, often unlikely conditional - "if only it were possible to...".
n2-155.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)
n2-155.chapterTitle: N2: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n2-006.title: A すなわち B。
n2-006.formation: Phrase A + すなわち + Phrase B
n2-006.shortExplanation: Express that A is equivalent to B; 'in other words', 'namely', 'that is to say'.
n2-006.usageNote: Very formal, literary "namely/that is" - legal, academic, or formal writing.

n2-010.title: A。それがB。
n2-010.formation: A (Statement)。それが B (Restatement or explanation of A)。
n2-010.shortExplanation: Expressing 'that's exactly what A is; in other words, B'.

n2-014.title: A。それなら B。
n2-014.formation: Situation A (sentence) + 。それなら + Situation B (sentence)
n2-014.shortExplanation: Express 'if that's the case, then'; used to show a logical consequence or decision based on a given situation.
n2-014.usageNote: それなら: in that case, then (sentence-initial).

n2-021.title: A。ということは B。
n2-021.romaji: A. To iu koto wa B.
n2-021.formation: A + ということは + B
n2-021.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning 'if A, that means B' or 'A implies B'.
n2-021.usageNote: ということは: which means that (sentence-initial).

n2-025.title: A。要するに B。
n2-025.shortExplanation: Expressing 'in short', 'in a nutshell', or 'to sum up' when restating or summarizing A as B.
n2-025.usageNote: 要するに: in short, to sum up (sentence-initial).

n2-091.title: ～というものだ
n2-091.shortExplanation: Expressing a general rule or common sense.
n2-091.usageNote: というものだ: that is just what X is, a general truth.

n2-134.title: ～のももっともだ
n2-134.formation: Verb-casual + のももっともだ, い-Adjective + のももっともだ, な-Adjective + なのももっともだ, Noun + なのももっともだ
n2-134.shortExplanation: Express that something is understandable or reasonable.
n2-134.usageNote: のももっともだ: it's understandable that (怒るのももっともだ).

n2-090.title: ～て当然だ
n2-090.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is natural or expected.
n2-090.usageNote: て当然だ: it is only natural that (怒って当然だ).

n2-034.title: Noun を もとに
n2-034.shortExplanation: Based on; drawing from; using as a reference.
n2-034.usageNote: をもとに: based on, using as a source (実話をもとに). Same as をもとにして.
n2-034.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-035.title: Noun を もとにして
n2-035.usageNote: をもとにして: based on, using as a source. Same as をもとに.
n2-035.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-122.title: ～に基づいて
n2-122.shortExplanation: Based on, according to, depending on
n2-122.usageNote: Formal "based on/according to" - policy, rules, or established facts, common in writing.
n2-122.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-127.title: ～に沿って
n2-127.shortExplanation: Along with; in accordance with; following
n2-127.usageNote: に沿って: along, or in line with (川に沿って, 方針に沿って).
n2-127.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-124.title: ～に応えて
n2-124.shortExplanation: Responding to; living up to; meeting.
n2-124.usageNote: に応えて: in response to, meeting a request (期待に応えて). Not に応じて.
n2-124.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-168.title: ～を中心に
n2-168.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is centered around or focused on a main topic or area.
n2-168.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-136.title: ～の下で
n2-136.formation: Verb-casual + の下で, い-Adjective + の下で, な-Adjective + の下で, Noun + の下で
n2-136.shortExplanation: Under the context or condition of; under.
n2-136.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-172.title: ～を頼りに
n2-172.shortExplanation: To rely on or depend on something or someone.
n2-172.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-032.title: Noun を めぐって
n2-032.usageNote: をめぐって: around an issue that people dispute (問題をめぐって議論する).
n2-032.chapterTitle: Based on, centred on, in line with

n2-041.title: ～がい
n2-041.usageNote: ます stem + がい: worth doing (やりがい, 生きがい).
n2-041.chapterTitle: Worth the effort, or in vain

n2-042.title: ～かいがあって
n2-042.formation: Verb-past + かいがあって / Noun + の + かいがあって
n2-042.shortExplanation: Used to express that an effort is worth it or has value; 'to be worth the effort' or 'to pay off'.
n2-042.usageNote: かいがあって: the effort paid off (練習したかいがあって).
n2-042.chapterTitle: Worth the effort, or in vain

n2-043.title: ～かいもなく
n2-043.formation: Verb-た + かいもなく / Noun + の + かいもなく
n2-043.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'without worth', 'in vain', 'fruitless'.
n2-043.usageNote: かいもなく: the effort was in vain.
n2-043.chapterTitle: Worth the effort, or in vain

n2-170.title: ～を込めて
n2-170.formation: Feeling/emotion/intention Noun + を + 込めて + Verb
n2-170.shortExplanation: To express that something is done with a certain feeling, intention, or emotion.
n2-170.chapterTitle: Worth the effort, or in vain

n2-180.title: ～切る
n2-180.shortExplanation: To do something completely or thoroughly.
n2-180.usageNote: ます stem + 切る: do completely, all the way (使い切る).
n2-180.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)
n2-180.chapterTitle: Worth the effort, or in vain

n2-076.title: ～つつある
n2-076.shortExplanation: Expresses an ongoing process or gradual change.
n2-076.usageNote: ます stem + つつある: a change in progress, gradually happening (written).
n2-076.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)

n2-045.title: ～がち
n2-045.formation: Verb-ます stem + がち / い-Adjective stem + がち / な-Adjective stem + がち
n2-045.shortExplanation: Expresses that something tends to occur frequently or habitually.
n2-045.usageNote: ます stem / Noun + がち: tends to, usually something bad (忘れがち).

n2-073.title: ～だらけ
n2-073.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is full of or covered with a certain (usually negative) characteristic.
n2-073.usageNote: だらけ: covered in something unwelcome (間違いだらけ).

n2-078.title: ～っぽい
n2-078.formation: Noun + っぽい, Verb-casual + っぽい, い-Adjective + っぽい, な-Adjective + っぽい
n2-078.shortExplanation: Indicates that something has the appearance, characteristics, or behavior of something else.
n2-078.usageNote: っぽい: -ish, looks like, or prone to (子供っぽい, 忘れっぽい).

n2-189.title: ～気味
n2-189.formation: Noun + 気味 (e.g., 風邪気味, 寝不足気味, 緊張気味)
n2-189.shortExplanation: Indicates a slight feeling or tendency toward a particular state.
n2-189.usageNote: 気味: a slight touch of (風邪気味).

n2-095.title: ～ところ
n2-095.formation: Verb-casual + ところ, い-Adjective + ところ, な-Adjective + なところ, Noun + のところ
n2-095.shortExplanation: Express a specific point in time or state; 'when', 'just about', or 'in the middle of'.
n2-095.usageNote: "Right at this point/just about to" - flexible, can mark just-before, during, or just-after a moment.
n2-095.familyName: Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)

n2-174.title: ～一方だ
n2-174.shortExplanation: Expresses that a situation or condition is continuing to increase or decrease in one direction.
n2-174.usageNote: 一方だ: keeps going one way, usually worse (悪くなる一方だ).
n2-174.familyName: Direction Of Change (From Now On / Up To Now)

n2-173.title: ～一方
n2-173.formation: Verb-casual + 一方(で), い-Adjective + 一方(で), な-Adjective + な/である一方(で), Noun + である一方(で)
n2-173.shortExplanation: Indicates that while one action or situation is happening, another action or situation is also occurring or is in contrast.
n2-173.usageNote: 一方(で): while X, on the other side Y; two sides of a situation.

n2-048.title: ～かねる
n2-048.shortExplanation: Express inability or impossibility of doing an action (often as a polite refusal).
n2-048.usageNote: ます stem + かねる: politely, 'I can't' (お答えしかねます).

n2-080.title: ～てかなわない
n2-080.formation: Adjective (〜く / 〜で) + て + かなわない / Verb phrase (reworded to an adjective/negative) + て + かなわない
n2-080.shortExplanation: Expresses that something cannot be endured, tolerated, or is unbearable.
n2-080.usageNote: てかなわない: unbearably, a complaint (暑くてかなわない).

n2-086.title: ～でばかりはいられない
n2-086.formation: Verb-て form + ばかりはいられない, Noun + ばかりはいられない, Noun + ばかり + Verb-て form + はいられない
n2-086.shortExplanation: Cannot afford to only do something; cannot always rely on it.
n2-086.usageNote: てばかりはいられない: can't just keep doing (泣いてばかりはいられない).

n2-083.title: ～でしょうがない
n2-083.formation: い-Adjective(く) + てしょうがない / な-Adjective + で(は)しょうがない / Verb-て form + しょうがない
n2-083.shortExplanation: Expresses an intense emotional or physical state; 'extremely', 'can’t help but'.
n2-083.usageNote: Casual, spoken "unbearably/can't help but" - the everyday way to express an intense feeling.

n2-097.title: ～どころではない
n2-097.formation: Verb-casual + どころではない, い-Adjective + どころではない, な-Adjective + どころではない, Noun + どころではない
n2-097.shortExplanation: Not the time/place for; far from; can't possibly.
n2-097.usageNote: どころではない: no time or place for that (勉強どころではない).

n2-146.title: ～まい
n2-146.shortExplanation: Express a negative conjecture or determination; 'probably not' or 'I will not'.
n2-146.usageNote: Formal, literary negative conjecture - "probably not/I won't" - the negative counterpart to だろう.

n2-144.title: ～は抜きにして
n2-144.usageNote: は抜きにして: leaving X out of it (冗談は抜きにして).
n2-144.familyName: Setting Aside (X Aside / X Is One Thing, But)

n2-050.title: ～か～まいか
n2-050.formation: Verb-volitional + か + Verb-volitional + まいか, い-Adjective + であるか + い-Adjective + であるまいか, な-Adjective + であるか + な-Adjective + であるまいか, Noun + であるか + Noun + であるまいか
n2-050.shortExplanation: Used to express a dilemma or indecision between two options or actions.
n2-050.usageNote: "Whether to do X or not" - the everyday version of the indecision pattern.

n2-092.title: どうにか～ないものか
n2-092.romaji: dō ni ka ~ nai mono ka
n2-092.formation: どうにか + Verb-negative form + ないものか
n2-092.shortExplanation: Express a strong desire or wish for something to be possible.
n2-092.usageNote: どうにか～ないものか: isn't there some way to (どうにかならないものか).
n2-092.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n2-159.title: ～やら～やら
n2-159.formation: Verb-casual + やら, い-Adjective + やら, な-Adjective + やら, Noun + やら
n2-159.shortExplanation: Expresses various items or actions, 'things like..., and so on'.
n2-159.usageNote: やら～やら: this and that, with a sense of chaos (宿題やら掃除やら).

n2-140.title: ～ば～というものでもない
n2-140.formation: Verb-ば form + というものでもない
n2-140.shortExplanation: Not necessarily true that if A, then B.
n2-140.usageNote: ば～というものでもない: doing X does not automatically mean Y.

n2-101.title: ～とは限らない
n2-101.formation: Verb-casual + とは限らない, い-Adjective + とは限らない, な-Adjective + だとは限らない, Noun + だとは限らない
n2-101.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is not necessarily true; 'not always', 'not necessarily'.
n2-101.usageNote: "Not always/not necessarily true" - the everyday hedge against a generalization.

n2-103.title: ～ないこともない
n2-103.formation: Verb-ないForm + こともない, い-adjective + こともない
n2-103.shortExplanation: Used to express an action or state is 'not impossible', but emphasizes reluctance or doubt.
n2-103.usageNote: "It's not impossible, but..." - emphasizes reluctance more than n2-102.

n2-051.title: ～からこそ
n2-051.formation: Verb-casual + からこそ, い-Adjective + からこそ, な-Adjective + だからこそ, Noun + だからこそ
n2-051.shortExplanation: Express the emphasis on the reason; 'precisely because', 'it is precisely because'.
n2-051.usageNote: からこそ: precisely because (好きだからこそ).
n2-051.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n2-052.title: 〜からして
n2-052.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is exceptional, unusual, or negative based on a particular aspect or point.
n2-052.usageNote: からして: judging from even X alone (名前からして怪しい).

n2-053.title: ～からすると
n2-053.shortExplanation: Expresses a judgment or evaluation based on a certain standard; 'from this perspective', 'considering', 'judging from'.

n2-054.title: ～からといって
n2-054.formation: Verb-casual + からといって, い-Adjective + からといって, な-Adjective + だからといって, Noun + だからといって
n2-054.shortExplanation: Expresses 'just because...doesn't mean' or 'even though...not necessarily'.
n2-054.usageNote: からといって～わけではない: just because X, it does not follow that Y.

n2-082.title: ～てこそ
n2-082.formation: Verb-て form + こそ / い-Adjective + くてこそ / な-Adjective + でこそ / Noun + でこそ
n2-082.usageNote: てこそ: only by doing X (やってこそ分かる).
n2-082.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n2-081.title: ～てからでないと
n2-081.shortExplanation: Indicates that something cannot be done before a certain action is completed; 'not until', 'only after'.
n2-081.usageNote: てからでないと: not until you have first done X (宿題をしてからでないと).

n2-028.title: Noun の ことだから
n2-028.shortExplanation: Used to provide a reason or explanation based on one's knowledge about the noun; 'since', 'because', 'knowing'.
n2-028.usageNote: Noun のことだから: knowing what X is like, I expect (彼のことだから).

n2-069.title: ～だけあって
n2-069.formation: Verb-casual + だけあって, い-Adjective + だけあって, な-Adjective + なだけあって, Noun + だけあって
n2-069.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is as expected or deserves its reputation.
n2-069.usageNote: だけあって: as you would expect from (プロだけあって上手).
n2-069.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-070.title: ～だけましだ
n2-070.formation: Verb-casual + だけましだ, い-Adjective + だけましだ, な-Adjective + だけましだ, Noun + だけましだ
n2-070.shortExplanation: Expresses that although the situation isn’t ideal, it could be worse; 'it’s not great, but at least...'.
n2-070.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-109.title: ～にかけては
n2-109.shortExplanation: Indicates a specific area or aspect in which someone or something excels.
n2-109.usageNote: にかけては: when it comes to X (a skill), nobody beats them.
n2-109.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-142.title: ～はまだしも
n2-142.shortExplanation: Expresses that while the first item is somewhat acceptable, the second item is not.
n2-142.usageNote: はまだしも: X would be one thing, but Y is too much.
n2-142.familyName: Setting Aside (X Aside / X Is One Thing, But)
n2-142.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-158.title: ～も同然だ
n2-158.formation: Noun + (も)同然だ, Verb-casual + (も)同然だ, etc.
n2-158.shortExplanation: Indicates 'as good as', 'virtually', or 'practically' the same as something.
n2-158.usageNote: も同然だ: as good as, practically (家族も同然だ).
n2-158.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-126.title: ～に決まっている
n2-126.formation: Verb-casual + に決まっている, い-Adjective + に決まっている, な-Adjective + だに決まっている, Noun + だに決まっている
n2-126.shortExplanation: Express certainty; 'it is obvious', 'it must be', 'no doubt'.
n2-126.usageNote: に決まっている: it is bound to be, certainly (負けるに決まっている).
n2-126.chapterTitle: As you would expect of it

n2-096.title: ～どころか
n2-096.formation: Verb-casual + どころか, い-Adjective + どころか, な-Adjective + どころか, Noun + どころか
n2-096.shortExplanation: Express 'far from', 'not just', 'not only', or 'to say nothing of'.
n2-096.usageNote: Stronger contrast - "far from it, actually..." - often flips the expected direction entirely.
n2-096.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-141.title: ～はともかく～は
n2-141.formation: Noun1 はともかく Noun2 は
n2-141.shortExplanation: Used to compare or contrast two elements; 'as for...'.
n2-141.usageNote: はともかく: X aside, Y is what matters (見た目はともかく).
n2-141.familyName: Setting Aside (X Aside / X Is One Thing, But)
n2-141.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-143.title: ～はもとより
n2-143.formation: Noun1 + はもとより, Noun2 + も
n2-143.shortExplanation: Expressing that something is obvious, and there is also something else.
n2-143.usageNote: はもとより: X goes without saying, and Y too (英語はもとより).
n2-143.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-157.title: ～も～ば～も～
n2-157.formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + も + (Verb/Adjective in ば-form) + も + (Verb/Adjective)
n2-157.shortExplanation: Lists multiple attributes or actions applying to the same subject: 'both…and…', 'not only…but also…'.
n2-157.usageNote: も～ば～も: both X and Y (勉強もできればスポーツもできる).
n2-157.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-176.title: ～上に
n2-176.formation: Verb-plain + 上に, い-Adjective + 上に, な-Adjective + な上に, Noun + の上に
n2-176.shortExplanation: Express 'in addition to', 'besides', 'not only... but also'.
n2-176.usageNote: Neutral "in addition to" - pairs two related facts/qualities.
n2-176.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-087.title: ～ではないか
n2-087.formation: Noun + ではないか / い-Adjective + ではないか / な-Adjective + ではないか / Verb-casual + ではないか
n2-087.shortExplanation: Used to show a strong assertion or emphasis on one’s opinion; 'isn't it?', 'aren't you?', 'right?'.
n2-087.usageNote: ではないか: isn't it (obviously)?, asserting an opinion.
n2-087.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-181.title: ～反面
n2-181.formation: Verb-casual + 反面, い-Adjective + 反面, な-Adjective + である反面, Noun + である反面
n2-181.shortExplanation: Express contrast between two aspects; 'on the one hand', 'on the other hand'.
n2-181.usageNote: 反面: one quality has a flip side in the same thing (便利な反面).
n2-181.chapterTitle: Far from it, let alone that

n2-100.title: ～と～ともに
n2-100.formation: Verb-casual + とともに, い-Adjective + とともに, な-Adjective + とともに, Noun + とともに
n2-100.shortExplanation: Expresses 'together with' or 'along with'; used to describe two events or actions happening simultaneously or in parallel.
n2-100.usageNote: "Together with" - two things happening in parallel.

n2-110.title: ～にしたがって
n2-110.shortExplanation: Expresses a natural consequence or a change that occurs according to something else; 'as', 'with', 'in accordance with'.

n2-113.title: ～につけ～につけ
n2-113.formation: Verb-casual + につけ, い-Adjective + につけ, な-Adjective + につけ, Noun + につけ
n2-113.usageNote: "Whether...or, in either case" - pairs two contrasting occasions.

n2-166.title: ～をきっかけに
n2-166.shortExplanation: Indicates that something serves as a trigger or starting point for another action/event.
n2-166.usageNote: をきっかけに: triggered by X, something started (結婚をきっかけに).
n2-166.familyName: Turning Point (Triggered By / From Then On)

n2-099.title: ～としても
n2-099.formation: Verb-casual + としても, い-Adjective + としても, な-Adjective + だとしても, Noun + だとしても
n2-099.usageNote: としても: even supposing it were so (雨が降るとしても行く).

n2-061.title: ～ことに
n2-061.formation: Verb-casual + ことに / い-Adjective + ことに / な-Adjective + なことに / Noun + のことに
n2-061.shortExplanation: Used to express feelings or emotions about a situation, action, or outcome.

n2-039.title: ～あまり
n2-039.formation: Verb-ます stem + あまり, い-Adjective + あまり, な-Adjective + のあまり, Noun + のあまり
n2-039.shortExplanation: Expresses the result of doing something excessively or beyond a certain point.
n2-039.usageNote: あまり: so much that it went too far (心配のあまり眠れない).

n2-151.title: ～ものがある
n2-151.formation: Verb-casual + ものがある, い-Adjective + ものがある, な-Adjective + なものがある
n2-151.shortExplanation: Express a strong impression or feeling; 'there's something about it that...'

n2-149.title: ～もかまわず
n2-149.formation: Verb-dictionary form + もかまわず, Noun + もかまわず
n2-149.shortExplanation: Express indifference or disregard; 'without hesitating', 'without worrying about'.
n2-149.usageNote: もかまわず: not caring about X (人目もかまわず).

n2-152.title: ～ものだ
n2-152.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものだ, な-Adjective + なものだ, (Also: Verb-た form + ものだ for recollections)
n2-152.shortExplanation: Expresses something natural or expected; 'it is normal that...', 'should', 'ought to'.
n2-152.usageNote: Moralizing "that's just how things are/should be" - general truths or social norms.

n2-154.title: ～ものではない
n2-154.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものではない
n2-154.shortExplanation: Expresses a strong negative suggestion or prohibition: 'should not', 'must not'.
n2-154.usageNote: A social/moral prohibition - "that's not the sort of thing one does" - rather than a hard rule.

n2-148.title: ～ままに
n2-148.formation: Verb-て + まま, い-Adjective + のまま, な-Adjective + なまま, Noun + のまま
n2-148.shortExplanation: Act according to; leave as is; unchanged.
n2-148.usageNote: ままに: just as something dictates (言われるままに), following it.
n2-148.familyName: Left As It Is (As Is / Left Undone)

n2-036.title: Verb ことなく
n2-036.usageNote: ことなく: without ever doing; written register (休むことなく働いた).

n2-037.title: Verb ないことには Verb ない
n2-037.formation: Verb-ない + ことには + Verb-ない
n2-037.shortExplanation: Express that something cannot be done without meeting a certain condition.
n2-037.usageNote: ないことには～ない: unless X happens, Y cannot (行ってみないことには分からない).

n2-027.title: Noun にて
n2-027.usageNote: Formal, literary "at/in/by" - ceremonies, formal writing, old-fashioned register.

n1-125.title: Verb たが最後
n1-125.formation: Verb-casual, past (た form) + が最後
n1-125.shortExplanation: Emphasizes 'once something happens, there is no going back'; 'once', 'as soon as', etc.
n1-125.usageNote: Very formal, literary - "once X happens, there's no going back"; emphasizes irreversibility, not just timing.
n1-125.chapterTitle: N1: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n1-129.title: Verb たら最後
n1-129.shortExplanation: Expresses that once a certain action happens, the situation changes irreversibly - usually in a negative way.
n1-129.usageNote: Formal, literary "once X happens, there's no going back (usually badly)" - near-synonym of n1-125's たが最後.
n1-129.chapterTitle: N1: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n1-163.title: Verbる なり
n1-163.usageNote: Formal, literary "the moment X, immediately Y" - written narrative style.
n1-163.chapterTitle: N1: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n1-174.title: Verbる や否や
n1-174.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'as soon as', 'the moment...'.
n1-174.usageNote: Formal, literary "no sooner than" - written narrative style.
n1-174.chapterTitle: N1: As Soon As (The Moment That)

n1-066.title: Noun に即した Noun
n1-066.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'in accordance with', 'based on'.
n1-066.usageNote: Formal, literary "in accordance with/based on" - policy, rules, or established facts.

n1-067.title: Noun に即して Verb
n1-067.shortExplanation: The grammar point Noun に即して Verb is used to mean 'to act in accordance with', 'in line with' or 'based on'.
n1-067.usageNote: Formal, literary "in accordance with/based on". (Verb-attached form of n1-066's に即した.)

n1-101.title: Noun を前提として
n1-101.shortExplanation: Used to express 'on the assumption of', 'based on'.
n1-101.usageNote: Formal "on the assumption/premise of" - written, argumentative, or planning contexts.

n1-121.title: Verb ずにはすまない
n1-121.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずにはすまない
n1-121.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot get away without doing X/is unavoidable".

n1-137.title: Verb てやまない
n1-137.formation: Verb-て form + やまない (common with certain verbs)
n1-137.shortExplanation: Used with certain emotional/mental verbs to show a strong, unceasing emotion: 'can't stop', 'never cease to'.
n1-137.usageNote: Formal, literary "never cease to..." - a strong, unceasing emotion, used with a narrow set of verbs (hope, love, wish).

n1-180.title: ～がゆえに
n1-180.formation: Noun / Verb / Adjective + がゆえに
n1-180.shortExplanation: Expresses the reason or cause; 'because', 'due to', 'as a result of'.
n1-180.usageNote: Formal, literary/academic; emphasizes logical cause-and-effect. Rare in speech.

n1-181.title: ～がゆえの Noun
n1-181.formation: Noun / Verb-dictionary form + がゆえの + Noun
n1-181.shortExplanation: Expresses the reason or cause for something; 'because of', 'due to'.
n1-181.usageNote: Formal, literary; noun-modifying form of がゆえに.

n1-184.title: ～こととて
n1-184.formation: Verb (plain form) + こととて / Noun + の + こととて / (な-Adjective + な) + こととて
n1-184.shortExplanation: Used to express the reason or premise for a decision or judgment; 'since', 'because'.
n1-184.usageNote: Formal, literary; specifically apologizes for or excuses an outcome as unavoidable given the circumstances - politely deflects blame, distinct from がゆえに's more neutral logical framing.

n1-058.title: Noun にして
n1-058.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea 'even for', 'even though', or 'in spite of'.
n1-058.usageNote: Literary "even for/even at (a point that would normally be enough)"; narrow, high-register usage.

n1-192.title: ～といえども
n1-192.formation: Noun + といえども / Verb-plain form + といえども / Adjective + といえども
n1-192.shortExplanation: Even if it is said that; Even though; Although.
n1-192.usageNote: Very formal, literary "even though/even if" - classical register.

n1-206.title: ～とはいえ
n1-206.formation: Noun + とはいえ, な-Adjective + だとはいえ, い-Adjective + とはいえ, Verb-casual + とはいえ
n1-206.usageNote: Formal "even though/that said" - softens a preceding statement with a caveat.

n1-215.title: ～ながらも
n1-215.formation: Verb stem + ながらも, い-Adjective + ながらも, な-Adjective/Noun + ながらも
n1-215.usageNote: Literary "even though/despite", pairs a state with a contrasting action taken anyway; more literary than にもかかわらず.

n1-046.title: Noun ともなれば
n1-046.usageNote: Formal, literary "once it reaches the point of/when it comes to".

n1-191.title: ～とあれば
n1-191.formation: Verb-casual + とあれば / い-Adjective + とあれば / な-Adjective + だとあれば / Noun + だとあれば
n1-191.usageNote: Formal, literary "if it comes to/should the case arise".

n1-200.title: ～とすると
n1-200.formation: Verb-casual + とすると / い-Adjective + とすると / な-Adjective + だとすると / Noun + だとすると
n1-200.shortExplanation: Expresses 'if', 'when', or 'assuming that' in a speculative sense.
n1-200.usageNote: Formal, literary "assuming that/if we suppose" - speculative register.

n1-030.title: Noun たりとも～ない
n1-030.formation: Noun + たりとも + Negative Verb
n1-030.shortExplanation: Used to show a strong negative: 'not even ~', 'not a single ~'.
n1-030.usageNote: Formal, literary "not even a single..." - absolute negation, emphatic.

n1-032.title: Noun ですら
n1-032.shortExplanation: Means 'even', 'as much as', used for emphasis in formal contexts.
n1-032.usageNote: Formal emphasis "even" - written/formal register, used for a striking example.

n1-060.title: Noun にすら
n1-060.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'even'; 'even in', 'even as', 'even to'.
n1-060.usageNote: Formal emphasis "even" - a variant of ですら for a different grammatical slot.

n1-063.title: Noun にもまして
n1-063.usageNote: Formal, literary "even more than X" - comparative emphasis.

n1-140.title: Verb ないまでも
n1-140.shortExplanation: 'Even if not to the extent of...', 'although not completely...'.
n1-140.usageNote: Formal, literary "even if not fully X, at least..." - a partial concession.

n1-199.title: ～としたところで
n1-199.formation: Verb-casual + としたところで / い-Adjective + としたところで / な-Adjective + だとしたところで / Noun + だとしたところで
n1-199.shortExplanation: Means 'even if' or 'even assuming'; emphasizes that the outcome won’t change.
n1-199.usageNote: Formal, literary - "even granting X, the outcome wouldn't change".

n1-193.title: ～といったらありはしない
n1-193.formation: Noun + といったらありはしない / な-Adjective + といったらありはしない
n1-193.usageNote: Very formal, literary exclamation - "extremely, beyond words"; dramatic, rare in casual speech.

n1-241.title: ～極まりない
n1-241.formation: な-Adjective（語幹）+ 極まりない, い-Adjective（連用形）+ こと + 極まりない, Noun + の極まりない
n1-241.shortExplanation: Expresses an extreme state, often negative; 'utterly', 'extremely', 'boundlessly'.
n1-241.usageNote: Formal, literary "utterly/extremely" - often for a negative extreme state.

n1-097.title: Noun をもって
n1-097.shortExplanation: Used to indicate means, methods, or time; 'with', 'by means of', 'at'.
n1-097.usageNote: Formal, literary "by means of/as of" - official announcements, deadlines.
n1-097.chapterTitle: N1: Formal Location (At / In, Official Register)

n1-110.title: Noun を限りに
n1-110.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'as of', 'with', or 'from', indicating the end of something or a point of change.
n1-110.usageNote: Formal, literary "as of (this point), marking an end" - announcements of a conclusion/cutoff.
n1-110.chapterTitle: N1: Formal Location (At / In, Official Register)

n1-107.title: Noun を禁じ得ない
n1-107.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot help feeling..." - specifically for an emotional reaction one cannot suppress.

n1-117.title: Verb ざるを得ない
n1-117.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ざるを得ない (する -> せざるを得ない)
n1-117.shortExplanation: 'Cannot but', 'have no choice but to', 'forced to'
n1-117.usageNote: Formal, literary "have no choice but to/cannot avoid doing" - circumstances leave no alternative.

n1-120.title: Verb ずにはおかない
n1-120.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずにはおかない
n1-120.shortExplanation: Expresses 'cannot help but...', 'will definitely...', or 'must do something'.
n1-120.usageNote: Formal, literary "will inevitably.../is bound to" - emphasizes an unavoidable natural consequence.

n1-139.title: Verb ないではすまない
n1-139.formation: Verb-ない form + ではすまない
n1-139.shortExplanation: 'Cannot end without doing', 'must do' - an unavoidable moral or social necessity.
n1-139.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot end without doing/is a moral obligation" - a social/moral necessity, not just circumstance.

n1-205.title: ～とのことだ
n1-205.shortExplanation: Expresses something that the speaker heard; 'I've heard that', 'I was told that'.
n1-205.usageNote: Formal, literary hearsay - "I was told that/it is said that".

n1-207.title: ～とみえて
n1-207.formation: Verb-casual + とみえて, い-Adjective + とみえて, な-Adjective + だとみえて, Noun + だとみえて
n1-207.usageNote: Formal, literary observational inference - "it appears that (judging from what I see)".

n1-061.title: Noun にとどまらず～も
n1-061.formation: Noun + にとどまらず + Noun + も
n1-061.shortExplanation: This expresses the idea of 'not only...but also', 'not stopping at...'.
n1-061.usageNote: Formal, literary "not stopping at X, also Y".
n1-061.chapterTitle: N1: Not Only But Also (Emphatic Addition)

n1-093.title: Noun もさることながら Noun も
n1-093.romaji: A mo saru koto nagara B mo
n1-093.formation: Noun1 + もさることながら + Noun2 + も
n1-093.shortExplanation: Means 'not only... but also'; the second noun is especially emphasized.
n1-093.usageNote: Formal, literary "not only... but especially" - emphasizes the second item as more notable.
n1-093.chapterTitle: N1: Not Only But Also (Emphatic Addition)

n1-164.title: Verbる にとどまらず～も
n1-164.formation: Noun / Verb-dictionary form + にとどまらず + も/ほかのこと
n1-164.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not only… but also', 'not limited to…'.
n1-164.usageNote: Formal, literary "not stopping at X, also Y". (Verb-attached form of n1-061.)
n1-164.chapterTitle: N1: Not Only But Also (Emphatic Addition)

n1-069.title: Noun に限ったことではない
n1-069.formation: Noun + に限ったことではない
n1-069.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is not only limited to; 'not only', 'not just'.
n1-069.chapterTitle: N1: Not Only Limited To (Far From)

n1-070.title: Noun に限ったことでもない
n1-070.formation: Noun + に限ったことでもない
n1-070.usageNote: Formal, literary "not only limited to...". (でも variant of n1-069's ではない.)
n1-070.chapterTitle: N1: Not Only Limited To (Far From)

n1-170.title: Verbる べく
n1-170.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'in order to', 'for the purpose of'.
n1-170.usageNote: Formal, literary "in order to"; written language, formal speeches.
n1-170.chapterTitle: N1: Purpose (In Order To / So That)

n1-237.title: ～んがために
n1-237.formation: Verb-negative stem + んがために, Verb-negative stem + んがため
n1-237.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the reason or purpose for an action; 'in order to', 'for the sake of'.
n1-237.usageNote: Very formal, emphatic literary "for the sake of/in order to"; found in formal writing, rare in speech.
n1-237.chapterTitle: N1: Purpose (In Order To / So That)

n1-002.title: A うと B うと
n1-002.formation: い-adjective (-かろう) + と, な-adjective / Noun + であろうと
n1-002.shortExplanation: Shows that the speaker is indifferent to both conditions; 'whether A or B'.
n1-002.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-004.title: A かれ B かれ
n1-004.formation: Commonly i-adjective stems + かれ + i-adjective stems + かれ (e.g. 早かれ遅かれ). Also sometimes Noun + かれ + Noun + かれ in older usage.
n1-004.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whether A or B'; both situations are included.
n1-004.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-006.title: A であれ B であれ
n1-006.formation: Noun A + であれ + Noun B + であれ
n1-006.shortExplanation: Indicates the same statement applies to both A and B; 'whether A or B'.
n1-006.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-008.title: A とも B とも
n1-008.formation: Noun + とも + Noun + とも (or sometimes Verb forms for each A, B)
n1-008.shortExplanation: Expresses two possibilities; 'either A or B', 'whether A or B'.
n1-008.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-009.title: A にしろ B にしろ
n1-009.formation: Noun A + にしろ + Noun B + にしろ, or Verb-casual A + にしろ + Verb-casual B + にしろ
n1-009.shortExplanation: Means 'whether it is A or B'; 'regardless of A or B'.
n1-009.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-010.title: A にせよ B にせよ
n1-010.romaji: A ni seyo B ni seyo
n1-010.formation: Noun + にせよ + Noun + にせよ (also works with verbs in dictionary form + にせよ)
n1-010.shortExplanation: Either A or B; Regardless of whether it's A or B.
n1-010.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-011.title: A につけ B につけ
n1-011.romaji: A ni tsuke B ni tsuke
n1-011.formation: Phrase A (dictionary/adjective form) + につけ、Phrase B (dictionary/adjective form) + につけ
n1-011.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-036.title: Noun といい Noun といい
n1-036.formation: Noun1 + といい + Noun2 + といい + Comment
n1-036.shortExplanation: Used to express 'both A and B'; 'whether it's A or B'; 'not to mention A and also B'.
n1-036.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-041.title: Noun といわず Noun といわず
n1-041.romaji: A to iwazu B to iwazu
n1-041.formation: Noun1 + といわず + Noun2 + といわず + (rest of the sentence)
n1-041.shortExplanation: Expresses 'both A and B' or 'be it A or B'; applies to both without distinction.
n1-041.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

n1-053.title: Noun なり Noun なり
n1-053.formation: Noun + なり + Noun + なり
n1-053.shortExplanation: Lists alternatives of the same kind; 'either A or B', 'A or B, for example'.
n1-053.usageNote: Formal, literary "either A or B, for example" - lists representative alternatives of the same kind.

n1-077.title: Noun のいかんにかかわらず
n1-077.formation: Noun + のいかんにかかわらず
n1-077.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of/irrespective of" - a noun-suffix variant using のいかん.

n1-079.title: Noun のいかんによらず
n1-079.formation: Noun + のいかんによらず

n1-091.title: Noun + はどうであれ
n1-091.shortExplanation: This phrase means 'regardless of' or 'no matter how…'.

n1-186.title: ～だろうとなかろうと
n1-186.formation: Noun / i-Adjective / na-Adjective / Verb + だろうとなかろうと
n1-186.shortExplanation: Expresses 'regardless of whether it is or isn't'.
n1-186.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of whether it is or isn't".

n1-210.title: どんなに～うが
n1-210.formation: どんなに + Verb-volitional + うが, どんなに + い-Adjective(～かろう) + が, どんなに + な-Adjective + だろうが
n1-210.usageNote: Formal, literary "no matter how much..." - emphasizes degree specifically.

n1-028.title: Noun ずくめ
n1-028.shortExplanation: Denotes 'entirely' or 'nothing but' the preceding noun.
n1-028.usageNote: Formal, literary "entirely covered in/nothing but X" - describes a state entirely characterized by one quality (e.g. dressed all in black).
n1-028.chapterTitle: N1: Totality (Entirely / Full Of / Covered In)

n1-071.title: Noun に限る
n1-071.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that 'nothing but', 'nothing is better than'.
n1-071.usageNote: Formal, literary "nothing beats X/best to do X" - a recommendation, not a plain restriction.
n1-071.chapterTitle: N1: Totality (Entirely / Full Of / Covered In)

n1-148.title: Verb ようか Verbるまいか
n1-148.romaji: Verb you ka Verb ru mai ka
n1-148.formation: Verb-volitional form + か + Verb-volitional negative form (まい) + か
n1-148.shortExplanation: Expresses indecision: 'Should I do it or not?'.
n1-148.usageNote: "Should I do X or not" - expresses indecision about a single action.
n1-148.chapterTitle: N1: Whether Or Not (To Do X)

n1-149.title: Verb ようが Verb るまいが
n1-149.romaji: Verb you ga Verb ru mai ga
n1-149.formation: Verb-volitional form + が + Verb-negative volitional form + が
n1-149.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whether or not', 'no matter if something happens or not'.
n1-149.usageNote: Formal, literary "whether one does X or not, (the outcome is unchanged)" - stronger, more declarative than ようか～まいか.
n1-149.chapterTitle: N1: Whether Or Not (To Do X)

n1-198.title: ～とされる
n1-198.formation: Verb-casual + とされる / い-Adjective + とされる / な-Adjective + だとされる / Noun + だとされる
n1-198.shortExplanation: Indicates a general belief or widely accepted view; 'is considered', 'is seen as', 'is said to be'.
n1-198.usageNote: Formal "is considered/is said to be" - reports a general, often official, view.

n1-208.title: ～とみられる
n1-208.formation: Verb-casual + とみられる, Noun + とみられる
n1-208.shortExplanation: It is considered that; It is thought that; It is believed that
n1-208.usageNote: Formal "is regarded as/is seen as" - similar formal reporting register to とされる.

n1-048.title: Noun なくして～はない
n1-048.formation: Noun + なくして + Sentence ～はない
n1-048.shortExplanation: Expresses 'without ~, there can't be ~'; 'can't do ~ without first doing ~'.
n1-048.usageNote: Formal, literary "without X, there can be no Y" - abstract/conceptual necessity.

n1-049.title: Noun なしでは～ない
n1-049.shortExplanation: Expresses the necessity of something; 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.

n1-001.title: A うが B うが
n1-001.formation: Verb-volitional form + うが + Verb-volitional form + うが, or Adjective (-かろう) + が + Adjective (-かろう) + が
n1-001.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'no matter how... or', 'even if... or'.
n1-001.usageNote: A うが B うが: no matter whether A or B. Same as うと～うと.

n1-005.title: A だの B だの
n1-005.formation: Noun/Verb casual + だの + Noun/Verb casual + だの
n1-005.shortExplanation: Used to list examples (often with a critical or complaining tone); 'things like A, B, etc.'.
n1-005.usageNote: だの～だの: complaining list of examples (高いだの遠いだの).

n1-007.title: A というか B というか
n1-007.romaji: A to iu ka B to iu ka
n1-007.formation: Phrase A + というか + Phrase B + というか
n1-007.shortExplanation: Means 'rather than say A, it's more like B', or 'whether to call it A or B'.
n1-007.usageNote: というか～というか: whether you call it A or B.

n1-012.title: A のやら B のやら
n1-012.romaji: A no yara B no yara
n1-012.formation: Noun1 + のやら + Noun2 + のやら (also works with adjectives and verbs + のやら)
n1-012.shortExplanation: Used when the speaker is unsure or confused between multiple possibilities.
n1-012.usageNote: A のやら B のやら: can't tell whether A or B (嬉しいのやら悲しいのやら).

n1-177.title: いつまで～のやら
n1-177.formation: いつまで + Verb (dictionary form) + のやら, いつ + Verb (dictionary form) + のやら
n1-177.shortExplanation: Expresses uncertainty regarding duration; 'don't know when... will end'.
n1-177.usageNote: いつまで～のやら: who knows how long it will go on.

n1-003.title: A かたわら B
n1-003.formation: Verb-dictionary form + かたわら, Noun + のかたわら
n1-003.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while also', 'at the same time as'.
n1-003.usageNote: かたわら: alongside a main occupation, also doing (仕事のかたわら).
n1-003.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-013.title: Noun1 が Noun1 なら、 Noun2 も Noun2 だ
n1-013.romaji: A ga A nara, B mo B da
n1-013.formation: Noun1 + が + (repeat Noun1) + なら、Noun2 + も + (repeat Noun2) + だ
n1-013.shortExplanation: Indicates a parallel or matching situation; 'if Noun1 is (truly) Noun1, then Noun2 is also Noun2'.
n1-013.usageNote: Noun が Noun なら: when X is like that, of course Y is too (親が親なら).
n1-013.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-014.title: Noun1 も Noun1 なら、Noun2 も Noun2 だ
n1-014.romaji: A mo A nara, B mo B da
n1-014.formation: Noun1 + も + (repeat Noun1) + なら、Noun2 + も + (repeat Noun2) + だ
n1-014.shortExplanation: Highlights two parallel facts or characteristics; 'if it’s said that ~, then it can also be said that ~'.
n1-014.usageNote: Noun も Noun なら: both X and Y are to blame (親も親なら子も子だ).
n1-014.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-035.title: Noun と Noun を兼ねて
n1-035.formation: Noun + と + Noun + を兼ねて
n1-035.shortExplanation: Used to indicate doing two things at once or fulfilling two roles/purposes.
n1-035.usageNote: と～を兼ねて: doing two things at once (観光と仕事を兼ねて).
n1-035.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-047.title: Noun と相まって
n1-047.shortExplanation: Used to express 'in combination with', 'together with', 'along with'.
n1-047.usageNote: Formal, literary "in combination with" - typically for multiple factors compounding together.
n1-047.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-094.title: Noun も兼ねて
n1-094.shortExplanation: Used to express 'as well as', 'also', or 'at the same time'.
n1-094.usageNote: Formal, literary "doubling as/also serving as" - describes one action serving two purposes.
n1-094.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-095.title: Noun も相まって
n1-095.shortExplanation: Used to express that combined with something else, it caused a certain outcome.
n1-095.usageNote: も相まって: combined with X, producing a stronger effect.
n1-095.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-055.title: Noun に Noun を重ねて
n1-055.formation: Noun に Noun を重ねて
n1-055.shortExplanation: This expression is used to describe repeated actions or states, 'one after another' or 'pile up'.
n1-055.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-130.title: Verb つ Verb つ
n1-130.formation: Verb-ますstem + つ + Verb-ますstem + つ
n1-130.shortExplanation: Expresses two alternating actions happening repeatedly.
n1-130.chapterTitle: Two things at once, two things alike

n1-015.title: Noun + あっての + Noun
n1-015.shortExplanation: Expresses 'B cannot exist without A'; 'B only exists because of A'.
n1-015.usageNote: Noun あっての Noun: B only exists thanks to A (お客様あっての店).

n1-052.title: Noun + ならでは
n1-052.shortExplanation: Expresses something unique or characteristic only of that noun; 'only found in', 'only possible with'.
n1-052.usageNote: ならでは: only possible for X (京都ならではの景色).

n1-096.title: Noun を おいて他に Verb ない
n1-096.formation: Noun + をおいて他に + Verb negative form
n1-096.shortExplanation: Means 'apart from ~ there's nothing else,' implying the Noun is the best or most suitable choice.
n1-096.usageNote: をおいて他に～ない: no one but X (彼をおいて他にいない).

n1-226.title: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ
n1-226.romaji: 〜no wa Noun gurai no mono da
n1-226.formation: Verb-casual + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, い-Adjective + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, etc.
n1-226.shortExplanation: Conveys that 'only (Noun) is the case' or 'nothing but (Noun)'.
n1-226.usageNote: のは Noun ぐらいのものだ: only X would (そんなことするのは彼ぐらいのものだ).

n1-235.title: ～もなんでもない
n1-235.formation: Verb-dictionary form + もなんでもない, い-Adjective + もなんでもない, な-Adjective + なもなんでもない, Noun + もなんでもない
n1-235.shortExplanation: Used to dismiss or negate something’s importance; 'it’s nothing at all', 'it doesn’t matter'.

n1-234.title: ～までだ
n1-234.formation: Verb (dictionary/ない form) + までだ, い-Adjective + までだ, Noun + までだ
n1-234.shortExplanation: Expresses a limit or extent; 'it's only up to...', 'no more than...'.

n1-018.title: Noun からある
n1-018.shortExplanation: Used with large numbers or measurements to emphasize 'at least that many' or 'no less than.'
n1-018.usageNote: からある: as much as, no less than, with a large amount (10キロからある).

n1-038.title: Noun というところだ
n1-038.shortExplanation: Means 'it's approximately...' or 'it's about...'. Used to show approximation or a general assessment.
n1-038.usageNote: というところだ: at most about, a modest estimate (7割というところだ).

n1-040.title: Noun といったところだ
n1-040.formation: Noun + といったところだ
n1-040.shortExplanation: Expresses 'at most', 'as much as', or 'limited to'.
n1-040.usageNote: Formal, literary "at most, roughly..." - a modest, understating assessment.

n1-022.title: Noun + ぐるみ
n1-022.shortExplanation: Describes 'entirely', 'all together', or 'as a whole group'.
n1-022.usageNote: ぐるみ: the whole group together (家族ぐるみ).

n1-111.title: Noun 並み
n1-111.shortExplanation: Indicates 'like' or 'as' something or someone; 'equivalent to', 'around'.
n1-111.usageNote: Noun 並み: on a par with, as much as (プロ並み).

n1-092.title: Noun まみれ
