n1-092.shortExplanation: Expresses a state in which something is entirely covered or filled with something else.
n1-092.usageNote: まみれ: smeared all over with (泥まみれ).

n1-182.title: ～から Noun に 至る まで
n1-182.formation: Noun (start) + から + Noun (end) + に至るまで
n1-182.shortExplanation: Expressing range from one thing to another; 'from...to', 'ranging from...to'.
n1-182.usageNote: Formal, literary "ranging all the way from X to Y" - emphasizes the full extent.

n1-043.title: Noun とは比べものにならない
n1-043.formation: Noun + とは比べものにならない
n1-043.shortExplanation: Indicates something is not comparable; 'beyond comparison'.
n1-043.usageNote: とは比べものにならない: can't even be compared (比べものにならないほど上手).

n1-232.title: ～ぶり
n1-232.shortExplanation: Expresses the amount of time elapsed since doing something last.

n1-019.title: Noun からする
n1-019.shortExplanation: Used to indicate that something is judged, estimated, or considered from a certain point or aspect.
n1-019.usageNote: からする: judging by (その口調からすると).
n1-019.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-020.title: Noun からの
n1-020.shortExplanation: Defines the starting point or the origin; 'from'.
n1-020.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-021.title: Noun から言わせれば
n1-021.shortExplanation: Express the perspective of the noun; 'from ~'s point of view.'
n1-021.usageNote: から言わせれば: if you ask X, in X's view. Same as に言わせれば.
n1-021.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-068.title: Noun に言わせれば
n1-068.shortExplanation: Expresses 'according to', 'if you ask', 'in the opinion of'.
n1-068.usageNote: に言わせれば: if you ask X, in X's view. Same as から言わせれば.
n1-068.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-102.title: Noun を前提にして
n1-102.shortExplanation: Assuming; presupposing; on the assumption of.
n1-102.usageNote: を前提にして: taking X as a given (結婚を前提に).
n1-102.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-109.title: Noun を踏まえて
n1-109.shortExplanation: Based on; taking into account; in light of
n1-109.usageNote: を踏まえて: taking X into account (結果を踏まえて).
n1-109.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-112.title: Noun + 前提で
n1-112.shortExplanation: Expresses a condition or requirement for something to be established: 'on the assumption that', 'under the condition of'.
n1-112.usageNote: 前提で: on the premise that (返す前提で借りる).
n1-112.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-209.title: ～とみると
n1-209.formation: Verb-casual + とみると, い-Adjective + とみると, な-Adjective + だとみると, Noun + だとみると
n1-209.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'when one sees it as', 'viewed as', or 'considering'.
n1-209.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-236.title: ～ものとして
n1-236.formation: Verb-casual + ものとして, い-Adjective + ものとして, な-Adjective + なものとして, Noun + のものとして
n1-236.shortExplanation: Indicates an assumption or supposition; 'assuming', 'under the assumption that'.
n1-236.usageNote: Formal, literary "under the assumption that" - written, formal planning/argument contexts.
n1-236.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-173.title: Verbる ものとする
n1-173.usageNote: ものとする: shall be treated as, in rules and contracts.
n1-173.chapterTitle: From whose standpoint, on what grounds

n1-023.title: Noun こそあれ
n1-023.shortExplanation: Expresses 'though there is ... (some negative or burdensome aspect), still ...'.
n1-023.usageNote: こそあれ: there may be X, but not Y (差こそあれ).
n1-023.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n1-024.title: Noun こそ～が
n1-024.shortExplanation: Emphasizes that 'it is precisely Noun that ...', then adds a contrasting or additional point.
n1-024.usageNote: こそ～が: X, yes, but (値段こそ高いが).
n1-024.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n1-025.title: Noun こそすれ
n1-025.formation: Noun + こそすれ + (negative or contrasting statement)
n1-025.shortExplanation: An emphatic pattern meaning 'it may be X, but definitely not Y.' Often pairs with a negative statement.
n1-025.usageNote: Noun こそすれ～ない: certainly X, never Y (感謝こそすれ).
n1-025.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n1-115.title: Verb こそすれ
n1-115.formation: Verb-ますstem + こそすれ、(絶対に)～ない
n1-115.shortExplanation: Often used in the pattern 'Xこそすれ、Y〜ない', meaning 'One might do X, but definitely not Y'.
n1-115.usageNote: Verb こそすれ～ない: may do X, but never Y.
n1-115.familyName: Emphasis With こそ (Precisely / Only By)

n1-059.title: Noun にして初めて
n1-059.shortExplanation: Expresses 'only when/after... for the first time'.
n1-059.usageNote: Noun にしてはじめて: only someone like X could (彼にしてはじめて).

n1-026.title: Noun ごとき / Noun ごとく
n1-026.formation: Noun + ごとき, Noun + ごとく, Verb-casual + ごとく, い-Adjective + ごとく
n1-026.shortExplanation: Means 'like a...', 'as if...', expressing a simile or metaphor.
n1-026.usageNote: のごとき / のごとく: like, as if (written) (夢のごとく).
n1-026.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-080.title: Noun のごとき Noun
n1-080.shortExplanation: Expresses 'like' or 'as if'; something/someone resembles something else strongly.
n1-080.usageNote: Very formal, literary "like/as if" - echoes classical Japanese; rare outside formal writing.
n1-080.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-229.title: ～びる
n1-229.formation: Adjective/Noun + びる (to form a verb)
n1-229.shortExplanation: A suffix meaning “to appear/to become ~,” often used with certain adjectives or nouns.
n1-229.usageNote: びる: take on the look of (大人びる, 古びる).
n1-229.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-233.title: ～ぶる
n1-233.shortExplanation: Used when someone is acting or pretending to be something they are not (often a negative connotation).
n1-233.usageNote: ぶる: act as if you were, put on airs (学者ぶる).
n1-233.familyName: Pretending (Pretend To / As If To Say)
n1-233.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-136.title: Verb てみせる
n1-136.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-211.title: ～と言わんばかりに
n1-211.formation: Verb-volitional + と言わんばかりに, い-Adjective + と言わんばかりに, な-Adjective + だと言わんばかりに, Noun + だと言わんばかりに, Verb + と言わんばかりだ
n1-211.shortExplanation: Indicates an action or behavior that strongly implies a certain unspoken message or feeling.
n1-211.usageNote: と言わんばかりに: as if to say (行けと言わんばかりに).
n1-211.familyName: Pretending (Pretend To / As If To Say)
n1-211.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-212.title: ～と言わんばかりの Noun
n1-212.formation: Verb-plain form + と言わんばかりの Noun
n1-212.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'as if to say'; 'almost says'; 'suggests'.
n1-212.usageNote: と言わんばかりの Noun: a look or tone as if to say.
n1-212.familyName: Pretending (Pretend To / As If To Say)
n1-212.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-238.title: ～んばかりに
n1-238.formation: Verb-negative stem + ん + ばかりに
n1-238.shortExplanation: Indicates 'as though about to ~' or 'as if to say ~'.
n1-238.usageNote: んばかりに: as if about to (泣き出さんばかりに).
n1-238.familyName: Pretending (Pretend To / As If To Say)
n1-238.chapterTitle: As if, seeming like, putting it on

n1-034.title: Noun ではあるまいし
n1-034.shortExplanation: Means 'it’s not as if...', 'it’s not that...', more formal than じゃあるまいし.
n1-034.chapterTitle: It's not as if, it won't do

n1-029.title: Noun だけではすまない
n1-029.formation: Noun + だけではすまない
n1-029.shortExplanation: Expresses 'it can't be settled with just...', 'cannot be resolved merely by...'.
n1-029.usageNote: Noun だけではすまない: X alone is not enough to settle it.
n1-029.chapterTitle: It's not as if, it won't do

n1-189.title: ～ではすまない
n1-189.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ではすまない / い-Adjective + ではすまない / な-Adjective + ではすまない / Noun + ではすまない
n1-189.shortExplanation: Expresses that just doing something is not enough or will not suffice.
n1-189.usageNote: ではすまない: X alone won't settle it (謝るだけではすまない).
n1-189.chapterTitle: It's not as if, it won't do

n1-033.title: Noun でなくてなんだろう
n1-033.formation: Noun + でなくてなんだろう
n1-033.shortExplanation: A strong rhetorical question: 'If not X, then what is it?'
n1-033.usageNote: でなくてなんだろう: if this isn't X, what is?
n1-033.chapterTitle: It's not as if, it won't do

n1-146.title: Verb やしない
n1-146.shortExplanation: Expresses a strong denial or refusal: 'I would never...', 'No way I would...'.
n1-146.usageNote: やしない: absolutely won't (分かりやしない).
n1-146.chapterTitle: It's not as if, it won't do

n1-031.title: Noun たる Noun
n1-031.shortExplanation: Indicates 'being in the position/state of', used for roles or statuses.
n1-031.usageNote: Noun たる者: someone who is a (教師たる者).

n1-044.title: Noun + ともあろう + Noun
n1-044.shortExplanation: Used to criticize or question unbecoming behavior by someone of a certain status.
n1-044.usageNote: ともあろう: someone of X's standing, criticized (社長ともあろう人が).

n1-057.title: Noun にあるまじき Noun
n1-057.formation: Noun1 にあるまじき Noun2
n1-057.usageNote: にあるまじき: unbecoming of (教師にあるまじき行為).

n1-042.title: Noun + ときたら
n1-042.shortExplanation: Expresses strong feelings about a topic; 'speaking of', 'when it comes to'.
n1-042.usageNote: Formal, literary, often exasperated - "when it comes to X (with strong feelings)".

n1-045.title: Noun ともなると
n1-045.shortExplanation: 'When it comes to...', emphasizes a change of situation or status.
n1-045.usageNote: ともなると: once X reaches that level (大学生ともなると).

n1-056.title: Noun にあっては
n1-056.shortExplanation: Indicates a specific situation or environment in which something happens or is the case.
n1-056.usageNote: にあっては: in the special circumstances of (この時代にあっては).

n1-051.title: Noun ならいざ知らず
n1-051.formation: Noun1 + ならいざ知らず + Noun2 (comment)
n1-051.shortExplanation: Expresses 'maybe X is possible, but Y is definitely not'. Often 'let alone...'.
n1-051.usageNote: Formal, literary "X is one thing, but Y is another (less certain) matter".
n1-051.familyName: Setting Aside (X Aside / X Is One Thing, But)

n1-062.title: Noun にひきかえ Noun は
n1-062.formation: Noun 1 + にひきかえ + Noun 2 + は
n1-062.usageNote: Formal, literary "in contrast to" - a deliberate, pointed contrast; written register.

n1-103.title: Noun を境にして
n1-103.shortExplanation: Means 'as a turning point', 'since (time)', or 'from (time) on'.
n1-103.usageNote: を境に(して): with X as the dividing line (その日を境に).
n1-103.familyName: Turning Point (Triggered By / From Then On)

n1-104.title: Noun を機にして
n1-104.shortExplanation: To take the opportunity to; taking the occasion to; on the occasion of.
n1-104.usageNote: を機に(して): taking X as the chance to (退職を機に).
n1-104.familyName: Turning Point (Triggered By / From Then On)

n1-108.title: Noun を経て
n1-108.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'through' or 'via'; going through some process or phase.
n1-108.usageNote: Formal, literary "via/through (a process or stage)" - describes a path or progression.

n1-131.title: Verb てからというもの
n1-131.romaji: Verb te kara to iu mono
n1-131.formation: Verb-て form + からというもの
n1-131.shortExplanation: Expresses that ever since a certain event happened, a condition has continued until now.
n1-131.usageNote: てからというもの: ever since X, things have been different.

n1-190.title: ～とあって
n1-190.formation: Noun + とあって / (Sometimes Verb + とあって, depending on context)
n1-190.shortExplanation: Expresses a special situation or event due to certain circumstances.
n1-190.usageNote: とあって: because of this special situation (休日とあって混んでいる).

n1-196.title: ～ときている
n1-196.formation: Verb-casual / い-Adjective / な-Adjective（＋だ） / Noun（＋だ） + ときている
n1-196.shortExplanation: Highlights a situation or condition that is serious/extreme, often with a negative nuance.

n1-100.title: Noun を余儀なくされる
n1-100.formation: Noun + を + 余儀なくされる
n1-100.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of being forced into a certain situation, 'to be compelled', 'to be obliged'.
n1-100.usageNote: を余儀なくされる: be forced by circumstances to (中止を余儀なくされた).
n1-100.familyName: Causative And Passive (Make / Be Done To / Be Made To)
n1-100.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-175.title: Verbる 始末だ
n1-175.shortExplanation: Indicates a (often unfortunate) result or conclusion of an action.
n1-175.usageNote: 始末だ: ended up in this sorry state (最後には泣き出す始末だ).
n1-175.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-084.title: Noun の極み
n1-084.shortExplanation: Used to express the extreme or utmost point of something.
n1-084.usageNote: Noun の極み: the height of (贅沢の極み).
n1-084.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-085.title: Noun の 至り
n1-085.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the height of', 'the extreme of' something.
n1-085.usageNote: Noun の至り: the utmost, in set phrases (光栄の至り).
n1-085.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-245.title: ～限りだ
n1-245.formation: い-Adjective + 限りだ, な-Adjective + な/である + 限りだ, Noun + の + 限りだ
n1-245.shortExplanation: Expresses an extreme degree of emotion or reaction; 'I feel so ~', 'as ~ as can be'.
n1-245.usageNote: 限りだ: I feel so very (嬉しい限りだ), the speaker's own feeling.
n1-245.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-242.title: ～極まる
n1-242.formation: な-Adjective（語幹）+ 極まる, い-Adjective（連用形）+ こと + 極まる, etc.
n1-242.shortExplanation: Also expresses an extreme degree or state, typically negative.
n1-242.usageNote: 極まる: extremely, usually negative (失礼極まる).
n1-242.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-195.title: ～といったらない
n1-195.formation: い-Adjective + といったらない / な-Adjective + だといったらない / Noun + だといったらない
n1-195.shortExplanation: Expresses the extreme of something; 'nothing can be more ... than this'.
n1-195.usageNote: といったらない: indescribably (寒いといったらない).
n1-195.chapterTitle: Forced into it, and the state it left

n1-098.title: Noun をものともせずに
n1-098.romaji: Noun wo mono tomo sezu ni
n1-098.formation: Noun + をものともせずに
n1-098.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that 'despite something, action was carried out', translating to 'without being fazed by something'.
n1-098.usageNote: をものともせずに: undaunted by X (嵐をものともせずに).
n1-098.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-099.title: Noun をよそに
n1-099.usageNote: をよそに: ignoring others' worry or concern about X.
n1-099.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-090.title: Noun はさておき
n1-090.usageNote: はさておき: setting X aside for now (それはさておき).
n1-090.familyName: Setting Aside (X Aside / X Is One Thing, But)
n1-090.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-087.title: Noun はおろか～すら
n1-087.formation: Noun1 はおろか, Noun2 すら/さえ ～
n1-087.usageNote: Formal, literary "not to mention X, even Y" - emphasizes Y as more extreme than the already-notable X.
n1-087.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-073.title: Noun + ぬいて
n1-073.shortExplanation: This is a way to express 'minus' or 'except for' some specific noun.
n1-073.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-072.title: Noun ぬいた Noun
n1-072.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'taking something out from something else'.
n1-072.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-197.title: ～ところを
n1-197.formation: Verb-ている + ところを / Noun + の + ところを / い-Adjective + ところを / な-Adjective + な + ところを
n1-197.shortExplanation: Indicates a contrasting or inconvenient timing; 'just when...', 'even though...'.
n1-197.chapterTitle: Unfazed by it, aside from it

n1-128.title: Verb たら きりがない
n1-128.formation: Verb-た form + ら + きりがない
n1-128.shortExplanation: Indicates an endless or unending cycle once an action is started; 'if one starts doing something, it will not stop.'
n1-128.usageNote: たらきりがない: once you start, there is no end. Same as ば / と きりがない.

n1-144.title: Verb ば きりがない
n1-144.formation: Verb-conditional form (ば) + きりがない
n1-144.shortExplanation: Indicates there's no end once you start listing, doing, or saying something: 'If one starts to..., there will be no end.'
n1-144.usageNote: ばきりがない: once you start, there is no end. Same as たら / と きりがない.

n1-160.title: Verbる ときりがない
n1-160.formation: Verb-casual + と + きりがない
n1-160.shortExplanation: Used to indicate that something can go on endlessly or without limits.
n1-160.usageNote: ときりがない: once you start, there is no end. Same as たら / ば きりがない.

n1-133.title: Verb ては
n1-133.shortExplanation: Expresses a repeated pattern or cycle, often implying a frustrating outcome; 'whenever X happens, Y happens again.'

n1-124.title: Verb そばから
n1-124.shortExplanation: Expresses that as soon as one action finishes, another begins immediately.
n1-124.usageNote: そばから: no sooner done than undone, again and again (覚えるそばから忘れる).

n1-156.title: Verbる が早いか
n1-156.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as soon as...' or 'the moment when...'.
n1-156.usageNote: が早いか: the instant X, Y (言うが早いか).

n1-127.title: Verb たら Verb たで
n1-127.formation: Verb-た form + ら + (same Verb-た form) + で
n1-127.shortExplanation: Conveys that if something happens (or doesn’t happen), there is a particular consequence or situation either way.

n1-119.title: Verb ずとも
n1-119.formation: Verb-negative stem + ずとも, Verb-ない stem + なくとも
n1-119.shortExplanation: Means 'Even without doing (X), (Y) can still happen'.
n1-119.usageNote: ずとも: even without doing, it is fine (言わずとも分かる).

n1-145.title: Verb もしないで
n1-145.usageNote: もしないで: without even doing, often a complaint (調べもしないで).

n1-158.title: Verbる こと なし に
n1-158.usageNote: ことなしに: without doing, and it cannot happen otherwise (formal).

n1-161.title: Verbる ともなく Verb
n1-161.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ともなく + Verb
n1-161.shortExplanation: Used to express 'without a particular intention', 'unconsciously', or 'before one knows it'.
n1-161.usageNote: ともなく: without really meaning to (見るともなく見る). Same as ともなしに.

n1-162.title: Verbる ともなしに Verb
n1-162.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ともなしに + Verb
n1-162.shortExplanation: Expresses doing something unintentionally or without conscious thought.
n1-162.usageNote: ともなしに: without really meaning to. Same as ともなく.

n1-118.title: Verb ずじまい
n1-118.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずじまい
n1-118.shortExplanation: Expressing regret for not having done something; not being able to; missing the chance to do it.

n1-185.title: ～ずにすんだ
n1-185.formation: Verb-ず form + に + すんだ
n1-185.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'was able to do without'; 'managed to avoid'.

n1-143.title: Verb の ない Noun
n1-143.formation: Verb in negative form + の + Noun
n1-143.shortExplanation: Used to modify a noun with a negative verb form; 'a Noun without (Verb)'.

n1-155.title: Verbる がままに
n1-155.shortExplanation: Expresses 'letting something happen as it is'; 'just as something does'.
n1-155.usageNote: がままに: letting things be as they are, not resisting (あるがままに).
n1-155.familyName: Left As It Is (As Is / Left Undone)

n1-213.title: ～ながらに
n1-213.formation: Common set phrases: 生まれながらに, 涙ながらに, 昔ながらに, 子供ながらに, etc.
n1-213.shortExplanation: Expresses a state or condition continuing just as it is (e.g. 'from birth', 'while crying', 'in the old way').
n1-213.usageNote: ながらに: while remaining so, since (生まれながらに, 涙ながらに).
n1-213.familyName: Left As It Is (As Is / Left Undone)

n1-214.title: ～ながらの Noun
n1-214.formation: Verb-ますstem (or plain minus る) + ながら + の + Noun
n1-214.shortExplanation: Indicates one action or state happening at the same time as the noun in question (e.g. 'dinner while watching TV').
n1-214.usageNote: ながらの Noun: a noun done while doing something (見ながらの食事).

n1-159.title: Verbる ことのないように
n1-159.romaji: Verb-ru koto no nai you ni
n1-159.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことのないように
n1-159.shortExplanation: Expresses the desire or effort to prevent something: 'so as not to...', 'to avoid...'.
n1-159.usageNote: ことのないように: so that X never happens (忘れることのないように).

n1-141.title: Verb ないものだろうか
n1-141.formation: Verb-negative (often negative potential) + ものだろうか
n1-141.shortExplanation: Expressing hope or wonder if something can be done: 'Isn't there a way...?', 'Can't we...?'
n1-141.usageNote: ないものだろうか: a hopeful 'couldn't it somehow' (formal).
n1-141.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n1-142.title: Verb ないものでもない
n1-142.formation: Verb-negative form (ない form) + ものでもない
n1-142.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that it's not entirely impossible or non-existent: 'It's not that I don't...', 'It's not that there aren't...'
n1-142.usageNote: ないものでもない: it is not out of the question.

n1-216.title: ～なくはない
n1-216.formation: Verb-ないform + なくはない, い-Adjective－い + くはない, な-Adjective + ではなくはない, Noun + ではなくはない
n1-216.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea 'it's not that it's impossible' or 'it's not that I can't'.
n1-216.usageNote: "It's not that it's impossible" - a hedged, soft admission.

n1-152.title: Verb ようにも
n1-152.formation: Verb-volitional form + にも + (reason/potential negative, etc.)
n1-152.shortExplanation: Used to express 'even though one wants to do something, one can't for some reason'.
n1-152.usageNote: ようにも～ない: can't even if you want to (行こうにも行けない). The attachment differs: Verb-volitional + にも is 'even if I try to V, I can't' (走ろうにも走れない), Verb-dictionary + にも is 'even to V, the means are lacking' (受けるにもお金が足りない).

n1-171.title: Verbる べくもない
n1-171.shortExplanation: Means 'it's impossible to...' or 'there's no way to...'.
n1-171.usageNote: べくもない: there is no way to (知るべくもない).

n1-168.title: Verbる べからざる Noun
n1-168.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べからざる + Noun
n1-168.shortExplanation: Used to express what should not be done; 'must not', 'should not'.
n1-168.usageNote: Archaic, literary; found in formal notices, mottos, or written rules - rare in modern speech.

n1-169.title: Verbる べからず
n1-169.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'must not do' or 'should not do'.
n1-169.usageNote: べからず: must not, on signs and rules (入るべからず).

n1-147.title: Verb よう
n1-147.formation: Verb (dictionary or negative form) + ように (する / etc.)
n1-147.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the way/manner of doing something' or 'in order to / so that / try to'.
n1-147.usageNote: ます stem + よう: the way of doing (話しよう).

n1-157.title: Verbる くらいなら
n1-157.shortExplanation: Expresses preference to avoid something: 'rather than...', 'if it comes to doing X, I'd rather...'.
n1-157.usageNote: くらいなら: rather than do X, I'd sooner (謝るくらいなら死ぬ).

n1-218.title: ～なら～なりに
n1-218.formation: Noun/Adjective + なら + (same Noun/Adjective) + なりに
n1-218.shortExplanation: Means 'if it is X, then it's X in its own way', emphasizing unique qualities.

n1-178.title: ～が Verb られる
n1-178.formation:
❶ (Group 1) Verb: 書く -> 書ける / 飲む -> 飲める, etc.
❷ (Group 2) Verb-ます stem + られる (食べる -> 食べられる、見る -> 見られる)
n1-178.shortExplanation: Expresses potential or ability to do something; 'can', 'able to'.
n1-178.usageNote: Literary potential form - directly conjugates the verb rather than using ことができる; more natural in writing.

n1-220.title: ～に堪えない
n1-220.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪えない, Noun + に堪えない
n1-220.shortExplanation: Indicates something is unbearable or not worth doing (e.g., 'unbearable to watch', 'unbearable to listen to').
n1-220.usageNote: に堪えない: unbearable to, or too much to (見るに堪えない).

n1-221.title: ～に堪える
n1-221.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪える, Noun + に堪える
n1-221.shortExplanation: Used to say that something is 'worth doing' or 'can stand up to' something (the positive counterpart of ～に堪えない).
n1-221.usageNote: に堪える: worth, able to stand (鑑賞に堪える).

n1-222.title: ～に耐える
n1-222.usageNote: に耐える: withstand pressure or hardship (寒さに耐える). Different kanji from 堪える.

n1-244.title: ～足る Noun
n1-244.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is worthy or sufficient to be called/used as ~; 'worthy of', 'enough to ~'.
n1-244.usageNote: に足る: worthy of (信頼に足る).

n1-243.title: ～足りない
n1-243.formation: Noun + (が) 足りない, Verb-casual + ほど/だけ + (が) 足りない

n1-224.title: ～に越したことはない
n1-224.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + に越したことはない, い-Adjective + に越したことはない, な-Adjective/Noun + である + に越したことはない
n1-224.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is the best or most desirable course of action; 'nothing better than...'.
n1-224.usageNote: に越したことはない: it is best to, nothing beats (早いに越したことはない).

n1-225.title: ～に難くない
n1-225.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に難くない (commonly with 想像する, 理解する, 察する, etc.)
n1-225.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not difficult to ~' in a formal/literary sense; e.g., 'not hard to imagine/understand'.
n1-225.usageNote: に難くない: not hard to (想像に難くない).

n1-176.title: Verbる 嫌いがある
n1-176.shortExplanation: Tendency to do a negative action; have a bad habit of ~.
n1-176.usageNote: 嫌いがある: has a bad tendency to (遅刻する嫌いがある).

n1-202.title: ～となったら
n1-202.formation: Verb-casual + となったら / Noun + となったら
n1-202.shortExplanation: Used to express 'if it comes to...', 'when it becomes the case that...'.
n1-202.usageNote: となったら: if it comes to that (行くとなったら).

n1-203.title: ～となると
n1-203.formation: Verb-casual + となると / い-Adjective + となると / な-Adjective + だとなると / Noun + だとなると
n1-203.shortExplanation: Used to highlight a certain circumstance; 'when it comes to...', 'if it becomes...', 'in the event that...'.
n1-203.usageNote: となると: when it comes to that, then (結婚となると).

n1-204.title: ～となれば
n1-204.formation: Verb-casual + となれば, い-Adjective + となれば, な-Adjective + だとなれば, Noun + だとなれば
n1-204.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'if it comes to...; when we talk about...; in the case of...'.
n1-204.usageNote: となれば: once it is the case that (そうとなれば).

n1-201.title: ～とすれば
n1-201.formation: Verb-casual + とすれば / い-Adjective + とすれば / な-Adjective + だとすれば / Noun + だとすれば
n1-201.shortExplanation: Used to express 'if it were the case that...', 'if we assume that...'.
n1-201.usageNote: とすれば: if we suppose that (事実だとすれば).

n1-223.title: ～に至った
n1-223.formation: Verb-てform + に至った or Noun / Verb-dictionary + に至る (more general).
n1-223.shortExplanation: Expresses the outcome or final conclusion of a process; 'reached the point', 'led to'.

n1-179.title: ～かと思いきや
n1-179.formation: Sentence + かと思いきや (Verb plain form, i-/na-Adjective, or Noun + だ + かと思いきや)
n1-179.shortExplanation: Expressing unexpected outcomes; 'just when I thought...', 'but...'.
n1-179.usageNote: かと思いきや: you would have thought X, but no (勝つかと思いきや負けた).

n1-113.title: Verbる / Noun(である) + 限り(は)
n1-113.formation:
Verb-dictionary form + 限り(は)
Noun(である) + 限り(は)
n1-113.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as long as', 'while this condition is true'.
n1-113.usageNote: Formal, literary "as long as (this condition holds)".

n1-227.title: ～ば～ものを
n1-227.formation: Verb-ば + Verb-past + ものを, い-Adjective + ければ + ものを, な-Adjective/Noun + であれば + ものを, etc.
n1-227.shortExplanation: Expresses regret or a missed opportunity: 'if only', 'had I but...'.
n1-227.usageNote: Formal, literary - expresses regret with a hint of reproach; "if only... (but you didn't)".
n1-227.familyName: Wish And Hope (I Hope / If Only)

n1-075.title: Noun+のいかんだ
n1-075.formation: Noun + のいかんだ, Noun + のいかんでは, Noun + のいかんで
n1-075.usageNote: Noun のいかんだ: depends entirely on (結果のいかんだ).
n1-075.chapterTitle: Depending on how it turns out

n1-076.title: Noun のいかんでは
n1-076.usageNote: Noun のいかんでは: depending on how X turns out.
n1-076.chapterTitle: Depending on how it turns out

n1-078.title: Noun のいかんによっては
n1-078.romaji: Noun no ikan ni yotte wa
n1-078.formation: Noun + のいかんによっては
n1-078.shortExplanation: Depending on the matter; depending on noun
n1-078.usageNote: Noun のいかんによっては: depending on X, possibly.
n1-078.chapterTitle: Depending on how it turns out

n1-039.title: Noun + というもの
n1-039.shortExplanation: Used to express a generic concept: 'all ~', 'any ~ of that kind'.
n1-039.usageNote: Noun というもの: things of that kind in general (親というものは).
n1-039.chapterTitle: Naming a thing, and seeing it through

n1-054.title: Noun なりとも
n1-054.shortExplanation: Indicates even a small amount or degree; 'at least', 'even a little'.
n1-054.usageNote: Formal, literary "at least/even a little" - emphasizes a minimal but real amount.
n1-054.chapterTitle: Naming a thing, and seeing it through

n1-074.title: ～ぬく
n1-074.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of doing something completely or thoroughly.
n1-074.usageNote: ます stem + ぬく: see it through to the end despite difficulty (走りぬく).
n1-074.familyName: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)
n1-074.chapterTitle: Naming a thing, and seeing it through

n1-126.title: Verb たことにしてください
n1-126.formation: Verb (past, casual) + ことにしてください
n1-126.shortExplanation: Asking someone to pretend or accept that something has already happened or taken a certain state.
n1-126.chapterTitle: Naming a thing, and seeing it through

n1-083.title: Noun の手前
n1-083.formation: Noun + の手前, Verb-casual + 手前
n1-083.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'Before doing something; on the verge of'.
n1-083.chapterTitle: Naming a thing, and seeing it through

n1-027.title: Noun じゃあるまいし
n1-027.formation: Noun or Na-Adjective + じゃあるまいし
n1-027.shortExplanation: Expressing that something 'is not'; 'it's not like...'. Colloquial/masculine form of ではあるまいし.

n1-135.title: Verb てまでも
n1-135.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even if it means doing...', 'no matter what it takes'.

n1-194.title: ～といったらありゃしない
n1-194.formation: Verb-casual + といったらありゃしない / い-Adjective + といったらありゃしない / な-Adjective + だ + といったらありゃしない / Noun + だ + といったらありゃしない
n1-194.shortExplanation: Emphasizes that something is to the extreme; 'you have no idea how...', 'it's incredibly...'.

n3-049.title: ですから～
n3-049.formation: Sentence A + ですから + Sentence B
n3-049.usageNote: Polite form of だから; safe in formal/polite conversation.

n4-003.title: A は B ほど～ない
n4-003.formation: A は B ほど + い-Adjective + くない, A は B ほど + な-Adjective + じゃない, A は B ほど + Verb-potential-negative
n4-003.shortExplanation: Expressing that A is not as ~ as B; 'not as...as'

n4-008.title: Noun に する
n4-008.shortExplanation: Used to indicate a choice or decision, 'to decide on' or 'to choose'.

n4-009.title: Noun に なる
n4-009.shortExplanation: To become; to change into; to turn into.

n4-034.title: Verb て いる
n4-034.shortExplanation: Expresses an ongoing action or a state resulting from a past action.

n4-090.title: ～たり～たり
n4-090.formation: Verb-ta + り + next verb-ta + り, い-Adjective + かったり + next verb-ta + り, な-Adjective + だったり + next verb-ta + り, Noun + だったり + next verb-ta + り
n4-090.shortExplanation: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'doing things like', 'and so on', 'etc.'

n4-094.title: ～でしょう
n4-094.formation: Verb-ますstem + でしょう, い-Adjective + でしょう, な-Adjective + でしょう, Noun + でしょう
n4-094.shortExplanation: A conjecture or probability; 'probably', 'I think', 'it seems'.
n4-094.usageNote: Polite conjecture - "probably/I think", softer and more polite than だろう.

n4-105.title: ～なくちゃいけない
n4-105.formation: Verb-ない form (-ない ending is dropped) + なくちゃいけない
n4-105.shortExplanation: Express the obligation to do something; 'have to', 'must', 'need to'.
n4-105.usageNote: Casual contraction (なくては -> なくちゃ); spoken, informal.

n4-120.title: ～んです
n4-120.formation: Verb-casual + んです, い-Adjective + んです, な-Adjective + なんです, Noun + なんです
n4-120.shortExplanation: Provide an explanation or reason; 'it is that', 'the thing is', 'the reason is'.
n4-120.usageNote: Casual, spoken contraction of のです - the everyday explanatory tone.

n5-004.title: A。じゃ、～B。
n5-004.formation: Sentence A. + じゃ、+ Sentence B. (A and B can be any sentence type)
n5-004.shortExplanation: Indicates a decision or suggestion; 'well then', 'in that case', 'so'.
n5-004.usageNote: Casual "well then/so" - the everyday spoken version of それでは.

n5-005.title: A。それじゃ、～B。
n5-005.formation: Sentence A + 。それじゃ、 + Sentence B
n5-005.shortExplanation: Connect two sentences; 'A, so/in that case, B'

n5-027.title: Noun ぐらい～
n5-027.shortExplanation: Express an approximate amount or degree; 'about', 'approximately'.
n5-027.usageNote: Slightly more colloquial than くらい for the same approximate quantity (rendaku softening) - interchangeable in casual speech.

n5-058.title: Verb る こと が できます
n5-058.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ことができます
n5-058.shortExplanation: Express the potential form, or the ability to do something.

n5-063.title: あまり～ないです
n5-063.formation: あまり + Verb-ないform + です / あまり + い-Adjective-くない + です / あまり + な-Adjective-じゃない + です
n5-063.shortExplanation: Express 'not really' or 'not very'; used to soften a negative statement.

n5-093.title: だれも～ないです
n5-093.formation: だれも + Verb-negative form (ないです), だれも + い-Adjective-negative form (ないです), だれも + な-Adjective-negative form (じゃないです)
n5-093.shortExplanation: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in a negative sentence.

n5-104.title: どこにも + Verb + ないです
n5-104.romaji: doko ni mo + Verb + nai desu
n5-104.formation: どこにも + Verb in ない-form + です
n5-104.shortExplanation: Express that an action cannot be performed anywhere or something cannot be found anywhere.
n5-104.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこへも variant of n5-105's どこにも.)

n5-106.title: どこへも Verb ないです
n5-106.romaji: doko e mo + Verb + nai desu
n5-106.formation: どこへも + Verb in negative form (ないです)
n5-106.shortExplanation: Express that an action doesn't take place anywhere; 'nowhere', 'not anywhere'.
n5-106.usageNote: Slightly more conversational variant, ないです instead of ません. (どこへも variant.)

n5-107.title: どこへも Verb ません
n5-107.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこへも variant, ません form.)

n5-108.title: どこも Verb ないです
n5-108.shortExplanation: Express that something cannot be found anywhere or in any place; 'nowhere', 'in no place'.
n5-108.usageNote: Slightly more conversational variant, ないです instead of ません.

n5-109.title: どこも Verb ません
n5-109.formation: どこも + Verb-ます form + ません
n5-109.shortExplanation: Express that 'nowhere' meets the verb action; 'nowhere does/can'.
n5-109.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこも variant of n5-105's どこにも - functionally identical.)

n5-117.title: なにも～ないです
n5-117.shortExplanation: Used to express 'not any' or 'nothing' in a negative sentence.

n5-130.title: まだ〜ないです
n5-130.shortExplanation: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet.
